Luis had built his life on being invisible and honest.

For 6 month and 4 days, his world consisted of spreadsheets that never balanced on the first try, petty cash envelopes that always came up short, and the particular hell of chasing department heads for receipts they’d "definitely left on your desk yesterday."
The other junior accountants had a nickname for their workspace: "the Dungeon." No windows, bad air, and stacks of paperwork that never seemed to shrink.
Luis had developed a careful routine - at 5:58 PM, he’d save his files twice (just in case), straighten his desk, and watch the clock hands crawl toward 6:00.
Home wasn’t entirely an escape either. It was just a little better than this office.
"Luis."
The sudden voice made him jerk, elbow bumping the little bamboo plant his wife had bought him for good luck. Director Liam stood over his desk, his sharp suit casting a shadow across his keyboard.
"You’re... reliable." Liam said it like it wasn’t quite a compliment.
He tapped the cubicle wall with well-groomed nails. "I have something to do outside. You’re covering Finance today."
Hearing this Luis mouth went dry. The Finance desk. Real money. Real responsibility. The stamp that could approve six-figure payments with one thump of authority.
"Just me?" he asked, trying to sound calm.
Liam smirked, "Yes, Don’t screw it up."
He walked off before Luis could reply.
Two hours later

A woman in a bright red dress burst into the office, her high heels clicking sharply against the floor. Two tough-looking guys followed close behind - assistants, probably, but they might as well have been bodyguards.
Without even looking at him, she slapped a piece of paper down on his desk.
Luis picked it up. His eyes widened at the amount - enough money to pay his salary for years. It even had the "pre-approved" stamp.
Then he saw the name.
Enes.
His hands went cold. He remembered the email from Boss Qin that everyone had gotten last week, the one in all caps.
[DO NOT PROCESS ANY TRANSACTIONS FOR ENES WITHOUT CHECKING WITH ME FIRST.]
He took a deep breath. "I’m sorry, but I can’t approve this without proper authorization."
The woman’s perfect smile disappeared instantly.
"Do you have any idea who you’re talking to?"
"Yeah," Luis said, his voice surprisingly calm despite his pounding heart. "That’s exactly why I can’t do it."
Her face twisted in rage. Then,
SMACK!
The folder whipped across his cheek. Papers exploded everywhere. As Luis staggered back, his head banged against the wall.
Everything went dark.
On the hospital bed in the hospital corridor, Luis had a bandage on his head and was receiving an IV drip, and the blood on his face and body had not yet been wiped off.
His mother-in-law Ruth, who was sitting next to him, had a livid face and angrily scolded, "Youidiot."
"One day.One daythey let you near real work, and you piss off the boss’s woman?"
Luis head throbbed. Blood crusted on his temple. The IV drip beside him swayed as Ruth stabbed a finger toward his face.
"You’re anobody. A replaceableclerk. And now you’ve made an enemy of someone who matters!"
His wife Lily, hovering behind her mother, whispered, "Mom, he was following rules—"
"Rules?" Ruth scoffed. "Men like him don’t get to enforce rules. Theyobey."

Ruth got even angrier as she spoke. She slapped the bed and said, "I finally found this job, but he offended the boss’s wife after just getting a proper desk job. I wonder why you were so blind to fall for such a poor, useless loser."
Ruth just turned forty, at the age of being as vigorous as a wolf. She looked very charming with her exquisite curly hair.
Although she had faint wrinkles beside the eye, her facial features were delicate and she looked very beautiful with light makeup. It was no exaggeration to say that she still had charm.
When she was young, she was a famous beauty in her family. She was tall and now she is slightly plump. She is not fat but mature, sexy and charming, which makes people feel amazing.
She has breasts and buttocks, and a perfect body with curves. She is wearing a low-cut top, and her cleavage and snow-white breast flesh sway when she moves. Even a bra cannot hide the shock.
Lily was so frightened by her mother’s yelling that she lowered her head and remained silent.

Ruth’s marriage was far from satisfactory, and her temper could be described as extremely violent. She was completely a shrew, sharp-tongued and mean-spirited, and when she hit menopause, it only got worse. When she got angry, it was truly terrifying.
"What did the doctor say!"
Ruth scolded for a long time before finally snapping, "If there’s no cure, just let him wait for death."
Lily cautiously replied, "Mom, the doctor said he needs to be observed overnight for a concussion."
"This useless boy already has a bad brain, what’s the point of observing him?"
Ruth stood up, picked up her bag, and said, "You stay here then. I don’t want to see him."
With that, Ruth left. Lily gave a bitter smile and sat down by the hospital bed, speaking softly, "Husband, are you okay?"
"A little dizzy!"

Luis felt somewhat dazed and couldn’t help but sigh in frustration. "Wife, I really don’t understand what Mom is thinking. A Accountant Clerk job only pays 2,170 a month, and she even said she had to pull strings for it."
"Tiger Real Estate is a leading company after all."
Lily comforted him, "Mom just wants what’s best for you."

Luis didn’t want to complain anymore. His mother-in-law was just vain, unwilling to support his freelance career. It was all about saving face when others asked, so she could say he worked at Tiger Real Estate.
"Rest well. Auntie will look into your work situation, and they’ll definitely have to compensate for the medical fees."
A nurse came to administer an IV drip. His wife, Lily, sat gently by his side, sighing helplessly.
Luis lay down, feeling somewhat disoriented as he looked at his wife. From head to toe, she could only be described with one word: Average.
She wasn’t tall or short, fat or thin. Her chest was small, and so was her butt. Her features were plain—neither beautiful nor ugly—with a birthmark on her face that made her deeply insecure.

The Wood family had three sisters. The eldest, Nancy, was tall and stunning, a bombshell. The youngest, Leah, was a petite, big-breasted girl. Even the mother-in-law was a voluptuous and glamorous mature woman.
Under their aura, Lily seemed like the ugly duckling by comparison. It was said that her father, Arthur, had even taken a paternity test at one point, suspecting this daughter wasn’t his.
After marrying into the Wood family, Luis lived a life of suffocating frustration. If there was one thing that kept him going, it might have been his wife’s gentleness.
"Sleep well, don’t overthink it."
Lily lowered her head shyly and held her husband’s hand.
Luis closed his eyes dizzily, feeling as if he were dreaming. Before him, a massive computer screen flickered with static.
"Signal connection successful..."
"Brainwave frequency stabilized, establishing network link..."
"Gene database backup complete, data calculation qualified, initiating host binding..."
Luis eyes widened as his entire body convulsed. His mouth opened, but no words came out.
After the strange voice spoke, an excruciating pain surged through him. Luis could clearly feel every cell in his body suffering as if electrocuted.
Under the intense pain, his body passed out again, but his consciousness remained active.
Luis found himself in a four-dimensional space, surrounded by lines of code flying past rapidly, accompanied by that hallucinatory, cold voice:
"Binding successful. Host: Luis Zester. Species: Human. Gender: Male. Age: 25..."
"Analyzing data parameters, gene data collection in progress..."
Luis shouted anxiously, "Wait, what the hell are you?"
The rapidly flashing code around him made him dizzy. Then, a monitor appeared before him, lighting up with a massive display:
"Host, it is an honor to be successfully paired with you."
"Host, what... what are you?"
Luis felt his head spinning. This dream was especially bizarre.
"I am a system, a system you summoned."
The monitor suddenly extended a USB interface, which forcefully connected to his brain. Luis watched in horror as the interface disappeared into his forehead.

In a distant advanced civilization, technology no longer required physical forms. This technological system, stranded on Earth, had been collecting data on lowly creatures like humans, slowly taking shape but never activating.

Today, Luis brain suffered severe trauma. Logically, he should have been brain-dead. But the sudden, intense fluctuation in his brainwaves matched the system’s frequency. With his genes deemed compatible, he instantly became its host.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Invite A Wolf Into The House
paragraphs: "The host’s genes are too ordinary!"
The system suddenly emitted a series of sounds:
"System functions fully activated, Lust System officially operational, generating beginner tasks, generating beginner gift pack..."
Luis was dumbfounded: "Lust System? What kind of ridiculous name is this?"
"The system absorbs human information from the internet. The most loaded data from men in front of computers is lustful content. The system has entered Lust System mode."
"Ding... Beginner gift pack, Ultimate Wife Gift Pack delivered. Please check, host."
"Ding... Beginner tasks generated. Please check the gift pack and complete them. Each task has corresponding rewards and attribute points."
"Beginner gift pack, open now?"
Luis’s mind was in chaos, feeling like he was playing a game. Subconsciously, he said, "Open."

"Congratulations, host. You have received the Ultimate Wife Gift Pack. Please complete the beginner task within one weekwife’s orgasm. Task completion comes with corresponding rewards. Task failure results in a 5 cm shortening of the dick."
"Shorten by 5 cm?"
Luis froze. Originally, Luis’s penis was only 10 cm long, a standard average size. If it were shortened by 5 cm, wouldn’t it just be a tiny nub???
"With rewards come corresponding punishments. Don’t men love swearing by this?"
"Please complete the task within the allotted time. Hint: Punishments and rewards are balanced."
Amidst the mental chaos, the sound of footsteps suddenly reached Luis’s ears. Weakly opening his eyes, he saw nurses and doctors coming for rounds.
What’s there to check for poor people sleeping in the hallway? Luis thought helplessly.
"Hubby, let me help you sit up!"
Lily’s voice was still as virtuous and gentle as ever.
Luis instinctively turned his head and was stunned. This... this was the beginner gift pack???
The Lily standing before Luis was a completely different person.

Not the plain and dull woman Luis had grown tired of, but a stunning beauty with delicate long hair, a strikingly pretty oval face, large sparkling eyes that looked pitifully charming, a petite upturned nose, and slightly parted cherry lips that were incredibly alluring.
"Due to your lustful thoughts, the beginner gift pack has transformed your wife into the woman you will like."
Luis’s mind was flooded with detailed information. After the transformation, she only appeared this way in his eyes. To others and herself, she still looked like the plain woman from before.
"Hubby, what’s wrong? Why aren’t you saying anything? Don’t scare me."
Seeing Luis motionless, utterly shocked and looking like he’d seen a ghost, Lily panicked, nearly crying. She immediately reached out to touch Luis’s forehead and called the doctor over.
"It’s fine, it’s fine. I think I just slept too much.", Luis reassured her.

Looking back at his wife, who was now talking to the doctor, Luis’s breathing grew heavy again. She was wearing an old-fashioned, conservative floral dress, but when she bent over earlier, he caught a glimpse of an incredibly deep cleavage.
Now, watching her from behind, her butt was perky, round, and plump. The feet peeking out from under her dress were absolutely delicate and exquisite.
Her figure was a perfect golden ratio with curves in all the right places, undeniably a devilish body.
"The Ultimate Wife is fully transformed according to your desires. People who know her won’t find her current figure strange, nor will they think it’s particularly attractive."
It can work like this??? Luis felt like his mind was blown.
"System, will no one really notice she’s changed?"
"Thoughts, personality, everything remains the same. Everyone who knows her will still see her as before."
What’s the point of even assigning tasks? Luis didn’t need any damn mission to make him want to turn into a horny devil with her.
After checking him, the doctor said, "You should be fine now. Go ahead and discharge."
Lily walked over, still worried. "Hubby, how are you feeling? If you’re not well, we can stay another day?"
"No, no, I feel fine."
Staring at her face, Luis felt like he was bursting with energy.
Leaving the hospital, they instinctively headed for the bus stop. Luis gulped and reached out to hold her hand, intertwining their fingers.
Lily let out a soft "ah~" and instantly blushed, lowering her head. "We’re an old married couple. What are you doing?"
"If we’re an old married couple, why are you blushing?", Luis grinned lewdly, staring at her beautiful face and exquisite figure.
On the bus, Lily cautiously said, "Hubby, Mom’s definitely going to nag later. Don’t talk back, okay?"
"Ugh... I’m used to it. I’ll just tune her out."
Luis could only laugh bitterly at the thought of his stunningly beautiful but shrewish Mother-in-law. Her temper was unbearable.
Arthur Wood kept another family outside and housed his first wife in a rundown resettlement housing complex in the suburbs. Though it was an elevator building, the neighborhood was mediocre.
The Wood family’s home wasn’t large—a small two-story duplex. The first floor had a living room, kitchen, dining area, and Arthur’s master bedroom.

The second floor had three rooms, one for each of the three sisters. The eldest, Nancy, was already married but still hogged the master bedroom. The second bedroom belonged to the youngest sister, Leah.
As a live-in son-in-law, Luis and his wife Lily were squeezed into the smallest children’s room—proof of their lowly status in the family.

Just like Lily’s pitiful standing at home, stuck in the middle, neither here nor there. The eldest sister scolded her, the youngest sister resented her, and even Mother-in-law Ruth disliked this plain, awkward daughter the most.
"What are you doing back so early?"
On the living room couch, Ruth was on the phone, wearing a simple strappy nightgown at home—clearly braless, her cleavage deep and mesmerizing.
"No, I wasn’t talking about you. It’s just that freeloader in my family coming home."
"Good, good. That’s fine."
Lily held Luis’s hand, standing before her mother like a child waiting to be scolded, too afraid to speak.
Ruth hung up and coldly eyed Luis, whose face was still bloody. She sneered, "Lucky bastard. Tiger Real Estate said they’ll let it slide. Take a week off, then go back to work."
"Mom, I don’t want that job. I can make more doing something else.", Luis couldn’t help but speak up.
Ruth exploded, slamming the table and pointing at Luis’s neck. "You little bastard, you’ve got some nerve! A jobless bum like you dares to talk back to me?"
"Mom, calm down. Luis didn’t mean it.", Lily was terrified and rushed to intervene.
But it was too late. Feeling her authority challenged, Ruth was furious. She stepped forward and slapped Luis across the face, snarling, "Listen here, you freeloader. Don’t push your luck."
She continued her tirade as Lily hugged her, nearly crying. "Luis, Luis, don’t make Mom angrier."
Caught off guard, Luis stumbled back from the slap, staring blankly at his cursing Mother-in-law.
"Ding... Main quest generated."
"Ding... Main quest: One of the Family. As a live-in son-in-law, you must turn the tables and show them what it means to invite a wolf into the house."

Suddenly, a computer interface appeared floating in front of him, displaying multiple side quests: Voluptuous and Seductive Mother-in-law, Tall and Alluring Eldest Sister-in-law, Girl with Huge Breasts Youngest Sister-in-law, along with several hidden side quests that were still obscured.
"Please complete the beginner task before proceeding with the conquest..."

Snapping back to reality, Ruth had already been calmed down by her daughter. Lily, eyes brimming with tears, kept apologizing. Seeing his wife’s timid, helpless look, Luis felt waves of wicked desire surging inside him.
Gritting his teeth, he bowed in apology. "Sorry, Mom. I spoke out of turn earlier."

Ruth, that shrew, immediately took advantage of the situation and started cursing, "Don’t be ungrateful. This job was arranged by your Brother-in-law. If you can’t even handle being a Accountant, you’re really waiting to die, you good-for-nothing."

"Let’s go!", Lily didn’t dare to stay any longer and quickly pulled Luis upstairs.

The second floor had three rooms and a very small living room. The couple’s bedroom was the smallest, originally a child’s room. With a bed, a wardrobe, and Luis’s computer crammed inside, it felt extremely cramped.
The tiny window did little to dispel the lingering smell of smoke.
The youngest sister, Leah, was a student and only came home on weekends. The eldest sister, Nancy, was already married, so the second floor was usually a quiet refuge for the young couple.
As soon as Luis sat down, Lily went to the room to find clothes for him and said, "Husband, you should wash up first."

Remembering the newbie mission assigned by the system and seeing his wife, Luis felt a surge of heat in his chest. He grabbed her hand roughly and said hoarsely, "I can’t get my head wet. Help me wash."
"Mom’s still home!!", Lily replied shyly, her usual timid demeanor resurfacing.
In the past, Luis had grown increasingly annoyed by her submissive and meek attitude toward everyone at home. But now, it looked so pitiful and adorable that it only fueled his lust.
"She’ll probably go out to play mahjong soon!"
Luis lit a cigarette and tempted her, "Go down and ask first. If it’s just the two of us, she definitely won’t want to eat at home."
"Then I’ll go check!", Lily was actually a bit eager too. She gave him a shy, flirtatious smile before heading downstairs.

Facing such a beautiful face, even though he knew the soul inside was still Lily’s, Luis couldn’t immediately show the intimacy he should have. It seemed he needed time to adjust to this sudden stroke of luck.
"System, how exactly is task completion judged?", Luis, being cautious by nature, immediately asked in his mind.
"Newbie Mission: Wife’s Orgasm. Task duration: one week. Please complete the newbie mission by giving her a sexual orgasm and advancing the ’Wife Corruption’ side mission."
"Just one orgasm is enough?", Luis was a bit surprised.
"Yes, just one. Comforting a wife and giving her oragasm is the exchange cost for the newbie gift pack."
The system’s voice was firm, making Luis light another cigarette as he fell into deep thought—or perhaps it was more of a guilty reflection on his lustful thoughts.

He and his wife had been high school classmates. Back then, Luis had pursued the school beauty with all his might, acting like a complete simp. At the beauty’s pitying request, he even arranged candles in the shape of a heart under the girls’ dormitory to confess his love.
The result? The school’s biggest bully mockingly wrapped his arm around the school beauty, and came over to kick over the candles, humiliating Luis in front of the entire school.

After that, Luis dropped out voluntarily. With no one to rely on, he knew that even if he got into college or vocational school, he wouldn’t have the money to attend. It was better to start working early to support himself.
Lily had been a quiet, plain-looking girl in their class with little presence. But she had silently started comforting Luis.

Whether it counted as her taking advantage of his vulnerability was debatable. Luis was decent-looking—handsome enough that he wouldn’t have noticed her under normal circumstances. But in that low state of mind, he’d practically pounced on Lily, who was still a virgin at the time.

The fiery passion between a virgin boy and a virgin girl, especially when the boy was in a volatile state, made their first time painfully awkward. They were even scared about whether they needed to go to the hospital.

After that, Lily had followed Luis with unwavering devotion. By the time she graduated from vocational school with mediocre grades, she confessed their relationship to her family and brought Luis home to meet her parents.
Arthur Wood wasn’t pleased but didn’t object. Ruth, however, had her own schemes at the time—it was a moment of crisis for her.

The eldest sister, Nancy, was already married. The youngest sister, Leah, was pretty enough to marry into a wealthy family. But this plain-looking second daughter was Ruth’s biggest headache. The paternity test incident had humiliated her deeply.

Back then, Arthur’s mistress was pressuring him to legitimize her position, and even the traditionally rigid Arthur was wavering. Ruth, in a panic, decided to bring Luis into the family as a live-in son-in-law.
The reason was simple: if all three daughters married out, what would happen to her? Arthur already had another family on the side. If she lost this house, she’d have nothing left.
At the time, the naive Luis had married Lily. Lily was overjoyed to be with the man she loved, but their married life wasn’t as happy as she’d imagined.
"Husband!", Lily came back upstairs shortly after, looking a bit happy as she said, "Mom said Sister and Brother are coming to see you tonight. They’ll have dinner here."
"Them? Since when are they so kind-hearted?", Luis’s first reaction was suspicion.

His eldest sister, Nancy, had always been arrogant. She’d married the son of a high-ranking official early on. Though the guy had been jailed for two years after a fight, his family was well-off, and he’d always looked down on his second sister and her husband.
If they cared about this family at all, it was only because of their sexy Mother-in-law and their petite, big-breasted youngest sister.
Before Luis could process this, Lily said softly, "I’m going to buy groceries. Sister and Brother will be here soon. You should rest for a bit."
With that, Lily hurried downstairs to start preparing. The moment she went down, Ruth’s unmistakably shrill voice rang out:
"Don’t be stingy with the groceries. Your Brother-in-law likes seafood. Get some good crabs and prawns, understand?"
"Oh, and buy a roast duck from the shop at the intersection. Your Sister loves that, and I’ve been craving it too."
Lily agreed meekly, while Luis, upstairs, burned with rage.

If only Ruth was home, even cooking rice would earn them a scolding for wasting gas. Occasionally, when Lily tried to show filial piety by buying seafood, Ruth would berate her for being cheap and having no taste, all because she’d married a loser.
Cooking was always Lily’s job, with Luis helping out. Yet Ruth would still nitpick over meals for three.

The worst was the roast duck shop at the intersection. If the eldest son-in-law bought it, Ruth would say she loved it. But if Lily bought it, she’d complain that it was greasy and unappetizing—a classic case of blatant favoritism.
There were too many little details in their daily life, but the treatment was completely different. Lily suffered even more than Luis did.
Luis realized that while he was unhappy and resentful, his wife had endured even greater hardships to maintain their relationship.

"Who are you pretending to be pitiful for? You poor loser should be used to this by now, stop putting on an act."
"Hurry up and wash, then get downstairs. Stop faking it."
After saying this, Ruth couldn’t hide the disdain on her face as she went downstairs. Luis was momentarily stunned, then gritted his teeth fiercely. He wanted to Kill her.

"Killing is considered task destruction. Violent methods are not allowed..."

The system’s voice was somewhat chaotic. Luis instantly realized its unique situation. This was a highly advanced system from an advanced civilization, but it was currently in a blank state.
Much of the data it collected was based on the grievances of the nerds in front of their computers. Due to special circumstances, it had been activated by him.
Currently, the system was only in its initial stage, still collecting data and establishing various standards. In other words, it didn’t yet understand how complex human desires could be.
In other words, the tasks it issued were based on the needs of the nerds in front of their computers. As for the rewards, it would depend on the rationality of these needs corresponding to the tasks.
Luis finally understood. This system had only activated its initial part and was still incomplete, leaving room for exploration.
After changing and washing up in the bathroom, although there had been blood, the wound on his head only required three stitches. The bruising was gone, and the wound had almost healed.

When he went downstairs after washing, his Mother In Law Ruth was wiping the table. The moment she saw Luis coming down dressed casually, her delicate eyebrows furrowed, and she scolded, "Can’t you afford to buy some decent clothes? You only have a few rags to your name."
"Mom, let me do it."
The hatred in Luis’s eyes flashed briefly, but he still suppressed it and obediently went to help mop the floor.
Ruth hardly did any housework at home. Whenever her wealthy son in law visited, she became extremely attentive, a typical petty person.
His wife Lily soon returned. Luis wanted to go help in the kitchen, but Lily carefully glanced outside and whispered, "Honey, you’re still injured. Go rest. Why did you come down?"
"It’s nothing."
Looking at his wife’s kindness, Luis felt exceptionally comforted.
Then the door opened, and Ruth’s delighted voice rang out, "Nancy, Daniel, you’re here so early? Dinner isn’t ready yet."
"Mom, we came to share good news."
The atmosphere outside was jubilant. Luis and his wife quickly came out to greet them. "Big Sister, Brother in law."
Big Sister Nancy was tall, standing at 172 cm. She had attended art school and always dreamed of becoming a celebrity. Her figure was curvaceous, with a perfect hourglass shape.
She had previously worked part time as a dance teacher but became a wealthy housewife after marrying into a rich family. However, she was also quite restless and still longed for fame.
Nancy wore light but exquisite makeup. Her appearance was stunning, with a hint of fox like charm in her eyes. She was the type who could enchant with a single smile.
Her entire outfit was branded, making her look glamorous wherever she went, no less dazzling than so called celebrities. It could be said she had surpassed her Mother In Law’s genes.
Brother in law Daniel dressed flamboyantly, clearly a playboy. He was even shorter than his wife, with a somewhat greasy appearance, short legs, and a growing belly.

Nancy was just being superficially polite.

Her hands were slender and beautiful, and it was said she had even worked as a hand model. She wore a dazzling diamond ring and had manicured nails, clearly not the hands of someone who did housework.

Daniel’s words carried a suggestive tone.
Nancy took a bite and immediately complained, "Second Sister bought this, right? If you’re not buying double shell crabs, at least get the ones with roe. What’s the point of buying these meat crabs?"
Daniel chuckled and said, "You don’t buy groceries, so you wouldn’t know. These meat crabs are the cheapest, almost half the price of the others."
Ruth’s face darkened. "Lily, what’s wrong with you? Are you so poor and stingy that you have to save money even when hosting your own sister and brother in law?"

Lily’s face turned red as she tried to explain, but Nancy immediately cut in, "Forget it, Mom. Second Sister’s job only pays a meager salary, and Luis is a deadbeat who’s dirt poor. At least she bought something."
Luis clenched his teeth and fists in anger. Lily’s face flushed as she said, "Big Sister, it’s not that I’m stingy. I just don’t know how to pick crabs."
"If you don’t know how to pick crabs, at least you should know what fish tastes good, right? Grouper isn’t even expensive now, so why buy these cheap pomfrets?"
Daniel poked at the fish with his chopsticks and said, "Luckily there are no outsiders here. Otherwise, people would think our family is dirt poor with such a shabby spread."
Lily silently lowered her head and continued eating, used to such taunts.
Luis was furious, but his wife’s hand under the table squeezed his, and he sighed, saying nothing.
After dinner, Lily was responsible for clearing the table and washing the dishes, as if it were a matter of course. When Luis tried to help, Daniel immediately called out, "Luis, come here."
The three of them were chatting happily, and this sudden summons left Luis no choice but to reluctantly sit down.

As soon as he sat, Daniel frowned and spoke in a condescending tone, "You really lack common sense. Honestly, it’s only because we live in a society governed by law. In the past, you’d have gotten another beating."

Luis couldn’t hold back anymore. "Brother in law, the rules there are like that. The boss has instruction that money should not be given to Enes. I was just staying on the Finance Director room for 2 hour, how could i have the access?"
"Your brother in law is scolding you for your own good, and you dare talk back?"
Ruth exploded with anger. "Rules are dead, but people are alive. Don’t you understand that?"
"Exactly. Use your brain when working. At the sight of that woman, you should’ve reported it to your supervisor. How could you be so stupid?"
After dinner, the activity became lecturing Luis. Watching his wife’s worried glances from the kitchen, Luis gritted his teeth and lowered his head.
In his heart, he thought fiercely, Just wait. Once I figure out the system’s functions, I’ll make you pay.
As they spoke, Daniel snorted, "The Finance team said it wasn’t entirely your fault. They’re giving you a week off and 1000 dollars for medical expenses."
Ruth immediately said, "It’s all because he lacks common sense. How can he have the nerve to take their money?"

Ruth grumbled.
Luis brewed the tea silently, cursing inwardly about how shameless it was to visit empty-handed.
Daniel was a playboy, the real idle good-for-nothing in the family.

His father was a school principal, and his mother was a department head at a major hospital. He was born into privilege, worked sporadically, spent money recklessly, and was the epitome of a spoiled rich kid.
He had pursued Nancy lavishly, and their wedding was reportedly grand. Arthur and Ruth felt their daughter had married exceptionally well.
Official status was unavoidable. Even though Daniel was a playboy with no real job, his family’s connections made him respectable, so the in-laws adored him.
After one cup of tea, Daniel got restless, "Mom, let me see your hand!"
Ruth extended her hand, complaining, "What’s there to see? It’s all old and wrinkly, dried up."
"Nonsense, Mom’s hand is softer than a young girl’s, smooth as silk."
Daniel flirtatiously held her hand, stroking it while saying, "Mom, it’s a shame you don’t wear any jewelry on these hands."
Ruth sighed dramatically, "Just a few old, broken pieces. Wearing them would be embarrassing. I don’t have the money for new ones now."
"Mom, I saw a beautiful bracelet last time, but someone already reserved it."

Daniel kept fondling his mother-in-law’s hand, smiling ingratiatingly, "Store-bought jewelry is mass-produced. Next time my friend’s high-end boutique has custom pieces, I’ll pick something beautiful for you."
"Really?"
Ruth was overjoyed but quickly feigned restraint, "You just got married and have expenses. Raising kids isn’t cheap, don’t waste money."
"Spending on Mom isn’t a waste."

Ruth giggled like a young girl, right in front of Luis, as if they were a pair of adulterers, completely ignoring him.
"Ding... Basic function unlocked successfully, displaying now."
"Ding... Only applicable to people you know, ineffective on strangers."

Above Daniel’s head, a line of text appeared: Favorability 0, Contempt, Disdain.
Above Ruth’s head: Favorability 20% (Worse than a stranger, looks down on him from the heart.)
Footsteps sounded on the stairs, and the two quickly separated. Listening to the sisters’ indistinct chatter, Luis turned to look.

Lily blushed, her text reading: Favorability 75% (A stable but dull marriage, built on first love and long-term relationship, boring sexual partner.)
Suddenly, the text disappeared, and Luis felt slightly fatigued.
"Display mode consumes energy. Normally hidden, but notifications will appear when favorability changes."
Luis thought this was fine. Otherwise, constantly staring at the numbers above their heads would make him look insane.

Lily lowered her head shyly, "What? Is there something on my face?"

Luis lifted her chin gently and kissed her.

Lily listened in a daze, her face turning red before tears began streaming uncontrollably down her face. Covering her mouth, she sobbed, "Husband, I feel like I’m dreaming."
"I’m sorry, I was too dense and lacked emotional intelligence before. I didn’t understand romance."
After finishing her hair, Luis hugged his weeping wife to comfort her, gently kissing away her tears as he said, "Alright, don’t cry!"
"Waaah!!"
The more he comforted her, the more emotional Lily became. Finally, she threw her arms around Luis and burst into loud sobs.
Shouldn’t she have been moved and become more docile instead? Luis hadn’t expected that a little tenderness from him would make her react so intensely.
For a moment, he was at a loss.
Lily cried until her face was streaked with tears, wiping them away like a messy kitten as she choked out excitedly, "Husband, I’m sorry too. Marrying me made you suffer so much."

Money, when spent on the right vanity, was irresistible to women like her.

"20,000 dollars!"
Luis made his choice without hesitation. After being poor for so many years, money was the most practical option.
Mostly, he didn’t trust his luck with the blind box. Right now, the only item left in his inventory was the "Male Aphrodisiac Incense," and he had no fucking clue what that was even for.
A text message arrived immediately. Luis happily checked the deposited money, his mood soaring.

"No, why are you using this number?"
"Brother-in-law, I need you to save me right now. Can you go to my room, grab something, and bring it to me?

Her big eyes blinked beautifully, full of spirit. Her nose was delicately upturned with a lovely shape, and her lips were red and luscious—a standard cherry mouth. Her skin was fair and exceptionally smooth.
She was like a finely carved doll, adorable with a hint of childish charm, paired with her curvy chest. She was the epitome of a girl with huge boobs.
"Brother-in-law!"
Her voice wasn’t deliberately coquettish just the natural, soft tone of a young girl, enough to make one’s bones tingle.

The way she walked up the steps made her chest jiggle noticeably, already sending Luis’s imagination into overdrive. What’s more, she was petite, probably not even 150 cm tall, barely reaching Luis’s chest when standing.
Perfect... Absolutely perfect. Luis couldn’t help but swallow hard.

Back when he first got married, he’d treated her like a kid and hadn’t interacted much. Now, upon closer inspection, he realized just how much of a gem his sister-in-law was—a girl with an incredible body.
"Leah, here’s what you asked for."
Luis handed her the red envelope.
Leah took it, then hesitated before shyly saying, "Brother-in-law, can you help me get a leave for the afternoon?"
"Uh... Shouldn’t you ask your mom about that?"
City No. 1 School had extremely strict rules. Students requesting sick leave needed approval from the school doctor, while personal leave required a guardian to personally apply.
Leah grinned mischievously. "Brother-in-law, I listed you as my guardian."
"Huh??"

Luis was baffled, but he successfully helped her get leave after registering his details. Once they stepped out of the school gates, Leah stretched and cheered, "Freedom~ I’ve been so bored these past few days!"
Just moments ago, she’d been acting obedient, but now she was back to her lively self. Luis asked in confusion, "Leah, why did you list me as your contact?"

He glanced at his sister-in-law and noticed she didn’t have a favorability display above her head, which puzzled him. Even though Nancy didn’t have an active task, her favorability was visible. Why wasn’t it working here?

Leah stuck out her tongue playfully and giggled. "Mom’s too strict, Big Sister loves to scold me, and Second Sister nags all the time. So I figured, why not list you as my guardian? That way, I can sneak out whenever I want~"
As she spoke, she skipped along, humming a tune. Even in her loose camouflage uniform, her chest bounced enticingly.
Luis swallowed hard and quickly caught up. "Leah, why didn’t you list your eldest brother-in-law instead?"
At this, Leah suddenly stopped walking. Her expression turned unreadable, not quite shy, more like angry. Her childish face flickered with uncertainty.
After a long silence, she forced a smile. "I was afraid he’d tell Big Sister. You’re more reliable, Brother-in-law. You’ll keep my secret, right?"
"You little rascal, what are you really up to?"
Luis sensed something off, but since she wasn’t saying, he didn’t press further.

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Looking Through Leah’s Texts
paragraphs: The conversation led them to a mobile phone store. Leah blushed as she took out her phone, an old and broken model from years ago with a cracked screen.
The repairman glanced at it and chuckled, "beauty, this model came out almost ten years ago. It’s a miracle it still works. If it’s broken, just get a new one. There’s no point fixing it."
Leah said somewhat guiltily, "But if it’s repaired, it can still be used!"
The repairman shook his head. "The parts for this model are hard to find now. I’m serious, you should just replace it."
Leah took back her phone, bit her lip, and lowered her head in embarrassment. Luis asked, "Leah, did you save up money just to fix this phone?"
"Yeah, otherwise it’s unusable."
Leah sighed helplessly. "I just put it under my pillow, but I ended up crushing the screen while sleeping."

She was still a student, and her family was very strict, not allowing her to use a phone. Only after she got into high school, for convenience, her mother Ruth handed her this old phone that her eldest sister Nancy had bought years ago. After a factory reset, it could still be used.

The phone could barely run any games, but Leah treated it like a treasure. Luis didn’t know whether to say she was too easily satisfied or to blame his mother in law Ruth for being stingy. The little academic achiever had done so well in her exams, and all she got was this piece of junk.
"Just get a new one. The parts for this kind really are hard to find now."
Luis couldn’t help but say the same.
"Mom would never agree!"
Leah lowered her head, looking pitiful. "Big sister and second sister are the same. They say it’ll distract me, but all my classmates have phones."
Ruth’s attitude was something Luis really didn’t want to comment on. What Leah said was true. She was already in high school. How could they control her so strictly?

What era was this? Her controlling nature was downright strict. To put it bluntly, other people spoiled their daughters, but with three, Ruth didn’t want to spoil any of them. Among her peers, carrying such a broken phone must have been humiliating.
"When this phone came out, your second sister probably hadn’t even gotten her period yet."
Luis couldn’t resist teasing.
Hearing this, Leah blushed but added, "I think I was still in elementary school back then."
Such words, paired with her petite, childlike appearance, had the potential to stir up beastly desires in anyone.
This kind of girl, showing a pitiful expression in front of you, was enough to break anyone’s heart at a glance.

Now that she was in her rebellious phase, Luis’s impression of her was that she always argued with her mother or sisters when she came home on weekends. As the bottom of the food chain, even Lily, who loved lecturing others, enjoyed scolding her. It was really quite pitiful.

To be honest, Ruth was also going too far. She spoiled her eldest daughter excessively, but giving Leah this piece of junk phone wasn’t even as good as handing scraps to a beggar. Anyone else would have already lost their temper.

Luis checked the time and said, "Leah, we don’t have much time at noon. How about this? Brother in law will take you to eat first, and then in the afternoon, I’ll go to the electronics mall. Anyway, you’ll be on break in a couple of days. You can take it home then."
"Brother in law, here’s the money!"
Leah immediately handed over the little red envelope she was holding.
This little sister in law was so well behaved and sweet that it was impossible not to like her. However, her small hand clenched the envelope slightly, clearly reluctant to let it go.
Luis pushed the little red envelope back and smiled. "Keep it as your pocket money. This small amount is nothing to me.
"Thank you, brother in law!"
Leah quickly put away the little red envelope and smiled sweetly, her expression almost making Luis lose control.

Little girls loved eating at KFC and McDonald’s. After taking her to eat nearby, he sent her back to school. In truth, the two of them didn’t interact much, and their relationship wasn’t very familiar. Making forced small talk was particularly awkward, but Luis enjoyed the envious and jealous looks from others.

After asking around at the electronics mall, everyone shook their heads at the sight of the broken phone. Fortunately, one repairman asked around and said, "I actually found some dusty parts that can be replaced."
This piece of junk probably wouldn’t even sell for 3 dollars, but fixing it cost 50 dollars. What kind of sucker would do that?
After the repair, Luis suddenly slapped his own head. What the hell was wrong with his dumb brain? When she said to fix it, he actually went and fixed it. Since when had he become so dense?
The aggrieved look in Leah’s eyes when she talked about her broken phone, along with the envy on her face when she mentioned her classmates, was clearly a perfect opportunity to get closer.

The quest line would inevitably start sooner or later, so he needed to prepare early. Daughters should be spoiled to prevent them from being tricked away with money. Since Ruth wasn’t spoiling her beautiful daughter, as her brother in law, he had no choice but to step up.
She used her secretly saved allowance to fix the phone, afraid that if she told Ruth, she’d get scolded again. This was the perfect time to play the role of the understanding big brother.
By the way, what about Ruth? Luis suddenly remembered something. If Ruth woke up remembering last night’s conversation, would it affect her favorability meter?

In the private room of the teahouse, the sound of cards being played filled the air. When Luis suddenly pushed the door open, Ruth, who had her back turned, didn’t see him and grumbled, "The service is so slow. With all the money they make every day, can’t they hire more staff?"
"Mom!"
Luis called out, causing Ruth to shudder, the card in her hand slipping onto the table.
She nervously rearranged her tiles before turning around, looking somewhat guilty as she said, "Why did you come all of a sudden?"
Yana, the young woman, said sarcastically, "You visit so often. Even a real son wouldn’t be like this. You really are lucky."

Luis greeted everyone with a smile, then placed a gift bag on the table and said softly, "Mom, you said the gold was too heavy and your hands hurt from playing cards while wearing gloves. I bought a lighter one for you to try."
Seeing it was from the same brand, the other three card partners’ expressions darkened, knowing Ruth would inevitably show off again later.
After putting down the bag, Luis quickly left, relieved to see that Ruth’s favorability meter remained at 50% without any fluctuations.

Back home, Luis found it somewhat amusing. The door to the master bedroom, which Ruth never used to close, was now locked. Was she afraid he would go in and replace the batteries of the dead vibrator?
The thought made Luis grin pervertedly as he pondered how to trigger the quest line.
Returning to Leah’s bedroom, he took out her snow white panties, but nothing happened. Though he didn’t have a fetish, he still licked them a few times, yet there was no reaction.

Not giving up, Luis went to his eldest sister in law Nancy’s room. Though Nancy rarely stayed over, there were still spare clothes here. Thinking of his tall, elegant eldest sister in law’s long, beautiful legs wrapped in black stockings, he found a pair of her old panties.
They were lace designed with cutouts, enough to make anyone fantasize, but even after licking until his lips were dry, nothing happened.
"What’s the problem?"
Disappointed, he lay on the bed, utterly confused. Why did Ruth’s panties trigger the system the moment he held them, but Nancy’s and Leah’s didn’t?
Bored, he noticed Leah’s repaired broken phone. Originally, he planned to hide it to avoid others seeing it, since Leah had secretly asked for his help out of fear of being scolded.
But as soon as he picked up the phone, he felt restless again and couldn’t resist opening it to take a look.
The call history was normal. The phone’s pitiful memory couldn’t even install Whatsapp, which was downright trash. On weekdays, Leah relied on the browser to read news, which was quite sad.
The search history was also clean. The more Luis looked, the more weird he felt. Everyone had their own privacy. There was no way Leah didn’t have any.
With that in mind, he opened the text messages. The earlier ones were normal, mostly promotional messages, but soon he found something exciting.
A classmate named Ojhaka seemed to chat with her often, discussing which male celebrities were handsome and even admitting they had watched porn together.
The next messages made Luis frown. They were from Daniel, the eldest brother in law.
"Sorry, Leah, brother in law didn’t mean to."
"That day at your place, I was a little drunk. When I went to the bathroom, I mistook you for your sister and spanked you. Brother in law really didn’t have any ulterior motives."
Luis couldn’t help but curse, "Daniel, you fucking bastard."
Your wife Nancy is 170 cm tall, while Leah is less than 150 cm. How could you mistake them? Only someone blind and brain damaged would believe such bullshit.
From the message history, it seemed Leah never replied, likely sulking.
Later, Daniel tried to tempt her by saying that since she did so well in her exams, he’d reward her with a new phone. Only then did Leah respond hesitantly.

However, judging by the messages, Daniel never actually bought it. He just said he’d secretly get her one when they met, then tried to invite Leah to go swimming, saying things like, "It’s so hot, let’s go to the water park."
Leah was quite alert, constantly asking if her eldest and second sisters were going too. Daniel avoided giving a straight answer, just beating around the bush.
Then came messages asking when she’d be home, saying he wanted to visit her, and so on...
"Daniel, you fucking bastard! You already have such a beautiful wife, and yet you still can’t keep your hands off your sister in law!"
Luis was furious. Though he himself now had perverted thoughts, at least he wasn’t as bad as Daniel. After all that talk, he still didn’t buy her the phone.
Wanting to flirt but unwilling to spend money? How did Ruth fall for his empty promises?
By this point, he already had a general idea, but Luis couldn’t resist looking through Leah’s messages with other classmates.
Most were normal, but one from a girl named Avery left him stunned.
The messages said that Avery’s sugar daddy had taken a liking to Leah, and this classmate was trying hard to persuade Leah to accompany him.

Leah refused, but the girl kept pestering her, tempting her with promises of a new phone and pocket money. What made Luis feel the worst was that Leah seemed to waver, asking how much money she could get.

Daughters should be spoiled to prevent them from being tricked away with money.
Since Ruth wasn’t spoiling her beautiful daughter, as her brother in law, he had no choice but to step up.
She used her secretly saved allowance to fix the phone, afraid that if she told Ruth, she’d get scolded again.
This was the perfect time to play the role of the understanding big brother.
By the way, what about Ruth?
Luis suddenly remembered something.
If Ruth woke up remembering last night’s conversation, would it affect her favorability meter?
In the private room of the teahouse, the sound of cards being played filled the air.
When Luis suddenly pushed the door open, Ruth, who had her back turned, didn’t see him and grumbled, "The service is so slow.
With all the money they make every day, can’t they hire more staff?"
"Mom!"
Luis called out, causing Ruth to shudder, the card in her hand slipping onto the table.
She nervously rearranged her tiles before turning around, looking somewhat guilty as she said, "Why did you come all of a sudden?"
Yana, the young woman, said sarcastically, "You visit so often.
Even a real son wouldn’t be like this.
You really are lucky."
Luis greeted everyone with a smile, then placed a gift bag on the table and said softly, "Mom, you said the gold was too heavy and your hands hurt from playing cards while wearing gloves.
I bought a lighter one for you to try."
Seeing it was from the same brand, the other three card partners’ expressions darkened, knowing Ruth would inevitably show off again later.
After putting down the bag, Luis quickly left, relieved to see that Ruth’s favorability meter remained at 50% without any fluctuations.
Back home, Luis found it somewhat amusing.
The door to the master bedroom, which Ruth never used to close, was now locked.
Was she afraid he would go in and replace the batteries of the dead vibrator?
The thought made Luis grin pervertedly as he pondered how to trigger the quest line.
Returning to Leah’s bedroom, he took out her snow white panties, but nothing happened.
Though he didn’t have a fetish, he still licked them a few times, yet there was no reaction.
Not giving up, Luis went to his eldest sister in law Nancy’s room.
Though Nancy rarely stayed over, there were still spare clothes here.
Thinking of his tall, elegant eldest sister in law’s long, beautiful legs wrapped in black stockings, he found a pair of her old panties.
They were lace designed with cutouts, enough to make anyone fantasize, but even after licking until his lips were dry, nothing happened.
"What’s the problem?"
Disappointed, he lay on the bed, utterly confused.
Why did Ruth’s panties trigger the system the moment he held them, but Nancy’s and Leah’s didn’t?
Bored, he noticed Leah’s repaired broken phone.
Originally, he planned to hide it to avoid others seeing it, since Leah had secretly asked for his help out of fear of being scolded.
But as soon as he picked up the phone, he felt restless again and couldn’t resist opening it to take a look.
The call history was normal.
The phone’s pitiful memory couldn’t even install Whatsapp, which was downright trash.
On weekdays, Leah relied on the browser to read news, which was quite sad.
The search history was also clean.
The more Luis looked, the more weird he felt.
Everyone had their own privacy.
There was no way Leah didn’t have any.
With that in mind, he opened the text messages.
The earlier ones were normal, mostly promotional messages, but soon he found something exciting.
A classmate named Ojhaka seemed to chat with her often, discussing which male celebrities were handsome and even admitting they had watched porn together.
The next messages made Luis frown.
They were from Daniel, the eldest brother in law.
"Sorry, Leah, brother in law didn’t mean to."
"That day at your place, I was a little drunk.
When I went to the bathroom, I mistook you for your sister and spanked you.
Brother in law really didn’t have any ulterior motives."
Luis couldn’t help but curse, "Daniel, you fucking bastard."
Your wife Nancy is 170 cm tall, while Leah is less than 150 cm.
How could you mistake them?
Only someone blind and brain damaged would believe such bullshit.
From the message history, it seemed Leah never replied, likely sulking.
Later, Daniel tried to tempt her by saying that since she did so well in her exams, he’d reward her with a new phone.
Only then did Leah respond hesitantly.
However, judging by the messages, Daniel never actually bought it.
He just said he’d secretly get her one when they met, then tried to invite Leah to go swimming, saying things like, "It’s so hot, let’s go to the water park."
Leah was quite alert, constantly asking if her eldest and second sisters were going too.
Daniel avoided giving a straight answer, just beating around the bush.
Then came messages asking when she’d be home, saying he wanted to visit her, and so on...
"Daniel, you fucking bastard!
You already have such a beautiful wife, and yet you still can’t keep your hands off your sister in law!"
Luis was furious.
Though he himself now had perverted thoughts, at least he wasn’t as bad as Daniel.
After all that talk, he still didn’t buy her the phone.
Wanting to flirt but unwilling to spend money?
How did Ruth fall for his empty promises?
By this point, he already had a general idea, but Luis couldn’t resist looking through Leah’s messages with other classmates.
Most were normal, but one from a girl named Avery left him stunned.
The messages said that Avery’s sugar daddy had taken a liking to Leah, and this classmate was trying hard to persuade Leah to accompany him.
Leah refused, but the girl kept pestering her, tempting her with promises of a new phone and pocket money.
What made Luis feel the worst was that Leah seemed to waver, asking how much money she could get.

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Resignation
paragraphs: "Look how old-fashioned you are! Everyone uses Whatsapp now, and you’re still texting."
"Come on, what era are you still concerned about?"
"My godfather said two thousand for one night, which is not a low price. If you are a virgin, he will give you another four thousand."
"Last time you were talking about a birthday treat, but do you have the money? We won’t go to those low-class places."
Luis frowned as he read every word. He knew that the school atmosphere was open now, but it was not open to this extent.
After reading the whole article, I can only say that this girl named Avery is also experienced and her words are very tempting.
"I’ll think about it!!"

The final message from sister in law Leah clearly showed hesitation, apparently she was also tempted. After all, Mother In Law had been strict and harsh since childhood, and this money would be a huge sum for her after buying a phone.
A few thousand dollars just to play with a virgin student girl, and such a top tier girl with a baby face and huge boobs, was this toad trying to eat swan meat?
Damn, if sister in law was really willing to do compensated dating, Luis would absolutely be the first to splurge on her.

During dinner time, Ruth returned home first. She carefully peeked at the door, and Luis, busy in the kitchen, turned around with a smile and said, "Mom, you’re back. Go change, we can eat once Lily gets home."
"Okay!"

Ruth saw that her son in law looked normal, while she felt particularly awkward. After returning to her room, she thought about it and changed into a relatively conservative nightgown, one that Luis had never seen before.

Taking a deep breath, Ruth walked into the kitchen, picking up the bowls and chopsticks while saying, "Son in law, Mom was a bit drunk last night and said some nonsense. I forgot what it was, don’t take it to heart."
"Got it, Mom!"
Luis hummed a tune while continuing to cook.

Ruth, holding the bowls and chopsticks, still felt uneasy and walked back into the kitchen, saying softly, "Son in law, when I said my hand was sore, I was just mocking those bitches. How could you take it so seriously and actually buy me another bracelet?"
"It’s only right to respect Mom. You can wear it however you like, why care about those bitches?"
Luis smiled gently.
The Mother In Law’s mission line hadn’t updated yet, which puzzled Luis a bit, so he acted normally, focusing entirely on his wife’s storyline.
When Lily returned, the delicious dishes were already laid out on the table.
Steamed spare ribs with black bean sauce, beef stir fried with green peppers, a plate of ginger scallion crab, a bought marinated pig’s ear, and a ginseng black chicken soup made for a rich spread.
"Delicious, son in law, your cooking is great."
Having let go of her worries, Ruth’s smile was noticeably warmer.
"Mom, this soup is especially good, nourishing and warming. Try it."
Seeing her husband praised, Lily, proud, quickly served her mother a bowl of soup.

The dinner atmosphere was rarely this harmonious. Before, Ruth didn’t want to cook, Lily came home late and cooked in a rush, and Luis, focused on not wanting to stay here, would just boil noodles, so such moments were few.
"Mom, my aunt asked how your job situation was going?"
Lily suddenly brought it up.
Ruth, who spent her days playing cards, couldn’t sustain the family’s finances like this. After losing too much, she wanted to work, but once Arthur’s fixed living expenses arrived, the idea faded.
"That’s a private hospital!"

Ruth said irritably, "It’s called a high end private hospital, but it’s just two things, giving birth and abortions or treating STDs. Your Aunt Yana works there, it’s indeed relaxed but the pay isn’t high, just a bunch of bitches comparing this and that all day."

Ruth studied nursing at a medical school, meaning she was a nurse, but without family connections, she couldn’t find a good job. She married Arthur early and had children, but her qualifications were solid.
When she lost money, she studied hard, took exams, and now had a decent professional title, but whether she could still do the job was questionable.
Lily let out an "oh" and didn’t dare say more, afraid of provoking the tigress in her mother.

Seizing the moment, Luis served Ruth some beef and said, "Mom, I don’t want to work at Tiger Real Estate anymore. It’s just a Junior Accountant Job, can’t make much money, really not as good as the side hustles I do."
"Ding..."
As soon as he finished speaking, the familiar sound rang in his mind: "Side job mission: Apology with a Cock in Mouth released. Reward: Mysterious and generous."
Lily also spoke up, "Yeah Mom, Luis has a lot to handle. That job is very tiring, when would he have time?"
Ruth gave her a flirtatious glance and teased, "You, just can’t bear to be apart from your husband, huh?"
Lily blushed, her face full of a satisfied and happy woman’s glow after being well loved.
Ruth looked at the dazed Luis and said, "Son in law, Mom isn’t unreasonable. If you think there’s no future there, then just resign."
"Really?"
Lily said happily, "Mom, you said before that even if it wasn’t for brother in law’s sake, it was for sister’s, afraid sister would feel awkward."
"That was before, now is now."
Ruth, usually someone who could make a scene over nothing, was uncharacteristically red faced. Two gold bracelets totaling 6,000 dollars had already bombarded her stance into oblivion.
"Son-in-law, what are you dazed about, say something."
Seeing Luis spacing out, Ruth frowned and asked.

Luis snapped back to reality. Though he couldn’t figure out what the side quest was about, he decisively said, "Mom, I’ll handle the resignation myself. No matter what, I’ve worked almost ten days. At the very least, I should get my salary."
"Husband, you still want to keep working?"
Lily looked reluctant. "Didn’t you say those computers of yours are worth at least tens of thousand?"
"Even ants are meat!"
Luis said sternly, "Over 400 dollars is still money. Mom, Lily, every penny is hard-earned. How we spend it is our family’s business, but when it comes to earning, we must earn every cent back."
"Son-in-law is right!"
Ruth laughed approvingly. "Seeing you so sensible makes me so happy. Lily didn’t choose wrong."
Previously, she had called her daughter blind and stupid, saying Luis was a worthless poor loser dragging her daughter down...
Remembering his mother-in-law’s past harshness, Luis felt his anger rise slightly. Her materialistic nature was still her essence. Some things couldn’t be covered up by this harmonious atmosphere.
After dinner, Ruth took the initiative to wash the dishes, while Luis held his wife’s hand and went for a walk.
When they returned at night, Ruth had gone out to play cards. The young couple exchanged a smile and went upstairs together for a shower.
"Husband, Mom asked yesterday when we’re having a baby."
"She said if there are issues, we should get checked early. Seems like there’s some big conflict with eldest sister."
Pillow talk always included some gossip, though it was accompanied by passion. After a round of intimacy, Lily was fucked into unconsciousness, her face covered in a satisfied smile as she panted.
Luis hadn’t come yet. Just one added attribute point in stamina was terrifyingly effective. He could have finished, but it felt like he could control it.
Life began to feel normal and peaceful. At the very least, no one looked down on this live-in son-in-law anymore. It all came down to the power of money.
The puzzling thing was that during this time, sister-in-law Nancy kept calling Ruth. It wasn’t clear what they discussed, but it seemed like they argued, ending unhappily.
When Lily tried probing, she got scolded, so Luis didn’t want to invite trouble.
The weekend arrived, marking the end of the first summer military training session. Before leaving for work, Lily reminded him, "Husband, pick up Leah after school."
Though the family treated her with material stinginess and strict control, they knew how society was.
Leah was a school beauty the moment she entered school, inevitably attracting all kinds of unwanted attention. Even Daniel was eyeing her, which showed just how attractive she was.
At the school gate, the little sister-in-law came bouncing over, and Luis’s eyes lit up. "Leah, you can rest well at home now."
"Brother-in-law, I knew it’d be you. Mom would never come."
Leah giggled, tossing her small backpack to Luis. "Brother-in-law, is my phone fixed?"
"Fixed!"
The entrance of High School was completely jammed. Since it wasn’t a main road, many drivers had no manners at all. Motorcycles were one thing, but cars parked here made the road impassable.
"Leah, what’s wrong? You stopped replying to my messages!"
Suddenly, a fairly pretty girl asked, glaring suspiciously at Luis, who was carrying the backpack.
Luis was baffled. Leah’s face turned red as she snapped, "My phone was getting fixed, none of your business!"
"Who is this guy?"
"None of your business!"
Leah cursed back fiercely, grabbed Luis’s hand, and quickly ran off. At the intersection, they hailed a taxi and went home.
"Brother-in-law, where’s my phone?"
The first thing Leah did upon arriving home was ask anxiously.
"Fixed. Like you said, I left it in your room and locked it. The key’s still in the usual spot."
Leah rushed back to her room with her backpack and slammed the door shut. Teenage girls were just full of quirks.

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Did You Peek At My Messages?
paragraphs: Luis sat in his room, racking his brain about how to unlock the questline. Suddenly, the door burst open—or more accurately, was kicked open.
"Brother-in-law, did you peek at my messages?"
"No, fixing a phone doesn’t mean peeking."
"The phone’s memory was laggy. There were browsing records when I opened it."
Leah’s eyes welled up with tears as she bit her lip, unsure how to respond before running back to her room and locking it out of habit.
But the moment she sat on the bed sulking, the lock clicked open. Luis closed the door behind him. "I put the key back where it was. Using it now isn’t too much to ask, right?"
"Of course it is! You’re just a pervert. Why did you look at my stuff after fixing my phone?"
Leah was furious, jumping up to shove Luis away.

Luis didn’t care, slamming the door shut with a loud bang, instantly sealing them in their own little world. Leah grew nervous, gritting her teeth. "Brother-in-law, don’t do anything stupid. I trusted you enough to ask for your help. Don’t think you can blackmail me."
Luis chuckled, sitting by the door as he lit a cigarette and took a drag.
The smell of smoke was the most hated thing in this household. Only Lily allowed Luis to smoke in their room. For everyone else, even the living room was off-limits.
Luis blew a smoke ring and smirked. "Leah, you’re really angry. You searched the room, didn’t you? But not thoroughly enough. If you’re worried I messed with your panties, go search properly."
"Brother-in-law, I didn’t mean that..."
Ignoring her, Luis went back to his room across the hall and lay down, his mind a mess thinking about his petite but busty sister-in-law. He had no idea how to unlock this questline.
"Ding... Questline not yet unlocked."
"Ding... Side quest generating."
Luis was beyond irritated when the door suddenly opened. Leah peeked in cautiously. "Brother-in-law, can I come in?"
"Whatever."
Luis was unusually irritable, mainly because he’d realized one thing:
The quest wasn’t up to him. His mother-in-law triggered one by taking panties. With Leah, things were already perverse enough, yet nothing happened. What the hell?
Leah closed the door behind her and stood there awkwardly. After a while, she bit her lip and said, "Brother-in-law, what exactly did you see?"
"Everything."
Luis looked at her pitiful expression, his wicked thoughts growing.
"What’s ’everything’? Tell me!"
The little sister-in-law was frantic, her face flushed red, on the verge of tears.
"Your eldest brother-in-law... I don’t believe it was an accident."

The room was small. Luis sat up and lit another cigarette, speaking sarcastically. "Your eldest sister’s height and yours—you’d have to be blind to mix you up. Your asses aren’t even at the same level."
Leah’s face turned crimson. She said angrily, "I thought so too. He was deliberately taking advantage of me."
Luis smoked silently. Leah pressed anxiously, "Brother-in-law, what else did you see?"
"I told you, everything!"
Luis gave her a meaningful look. "Leah, to sound old-fashioned, as your brother-in-law, I should lecture you. But I know I don’t have the right."
"I... I didn’t agree to Avery!!
Leah panicked, confessing without being pressed, but then guiltily lowered her head.
After a moment, she grew angry again, her eyes welling with tears. "Brother-in-law, how could you do this? I trusted you enough to ask for your help. How could you invade my privacy?"
The term sounded lofty. Luis couldn’t help but laugh at her childish face. "Leah, I admit I was wrong. I won’t make excuses, but I have a suggestion to make it up to you."
Leah stubbornly wiped away her few tears and sniffled. "What suggestion?"
Luis grinned. "Everyone has their own secrets, or shared secrets. I promise I won’t tell anyone what I saw. This’ll be our little secret."
"You... you can’t tell anyone, especially Mom..."
Leah was so mad she rolled her eyes, but she didn’t know what to do. The matter was too embarrassing to bring up.
Seeing she was genuinely angry, Luis teased, "Our Leah is so pretty. Even when angry, you’re adorable."
"Who asked for your praise, you pervert, you disgusting peeping tom!"
Leah snatched the room key from the table. The more she thought about it, the angrier and more wronged she felt. With a loud wail, she ran back to her room in tears.
The door slammed shut again. Luckily, no one was home, or it’d be hard to explain.

Back in her room, Leah cried on her bed, pounding her pillow in frustration. "Eldest brother-in-law is a creep. Second brother-in-law seems nice but is actually a pervert, a huge pervert, a disgusting pervert..."
"Why did you have to peek at my phone..."
Crying like a mess, her phone suddenly buzzed with a message. Leah wiped her tears and froze when she saw it.
"Leah, your brother-in-law is even more perverted than you think. Guess what’s new in your room?"
"Disgusting pervert, don’t tell me..."

Remembering stories about men’s fetishes—how underwear and stockings would go missing when hung outside, stolen by perverts who’d jerk off onto them—Leah hurriedly wiped her tears and opened her closet, pulling out the drawer where she kept her panties.
Inside was a piece of paper.
It was a shopping receipt from the mall, dated that morning. The item purchased was the latest top-of-the-line iPhone 14, costing over a thousand dollars.
Leah stared at the receipt, confused about Luis’s intentions.
Another message arrived: "Perverted brother-in-law peeked at your panties. Is Leah even angrier now?"
"Disgusting pervert!"
Leah stopped crying but didn’t reply.
The girl sat on her bed, staring at the receipt. Of course she knew about this latest luxury phone. Nowadays, everyone had a phone, usually a cheap hand-me-down from their parents.
An iPhone worth a few thousand was already impressive. This one, costing over a thousand, wasn’t something anyone at school had yet. It was the stuff of heated discussions.

Lily was slow to realize that a high school girl like Leah, who mostly wore uniforms, would only need ill-fitting clothes if they were underwear.
Asking her husband to take his teenage sister-in-law underwear shopping was a questionable move, and she only now sensed it might be inappropriate.
"No need to take time off."

"Okay, honey. Thanks for your hard work."
After hanging up, Leah said sheepishly, "Brother, it’d actually be nice if Sister came."

Luis reached out and grabbed her hand again.

"What’s too far? Holding a kid’s hand in the mall is to prevent them from getting lost."

His bluntness made Leah lower her head in embarrassment, grumbling about Luis becoming more and more excessive.

"Not just small, but also especially pretty!"
Luis didn’t hold back his praise.

Leah’s face turned even redder, but her eyes were much gentler than before, glistening with a hint of moisture. She looked at the shoes, her eyes lighting up, but then said somewhat coyly, "Brother, actually, other shoes are quite pretty too."
Earlier, when passing by the store, she had glanced at these shoes a few times. Luis noticed this detail and asked if she liked them.

Leah blushed and nodded, saying that her school required students to wear sports shoes for class, and this particular style was very popular among the girls at her school. She had seen many girls wearing them.
The envy in her voice was unmistakable, so Luis directly pulled her into the store.
Luis didn’t say much, humming a tune as he put on disposable socks for her, then personally helped her into the sports shoes and said with a smile, "Stand up and walk around to see if they fit."
Leah stood up and took a few steps, her eyes clearly unable to hide her delight. Luis asked again with concern, "How are they? Do they fit?"
"They’re perfect~!"
Leah, who had been acting shy all day, gave Luis a sweet smile.
"Brother in law, you’re so good."

Hearing this, Luis felt all the motivation in the world surge through him. Without hesitation, he swiped his card and went on a shopping spree, buying so many things, even slippers and sandals, that Leah was left in a daze.
In the taxi on the way home, the bags were piled to the side. Luis still held her hand, but this time, he began to caress her delicate fingers without restraint.
Leah’s face flushed, and she trembled slightly, letting Luis touch her. At this moment, she was overjoyed, having finally gotten her fill of the shopping high.
For her, this was definitely a luxury splurge, but she couldn’t hide the unease in her heart.
"Brother in law... you spent so much money. How are you going to explain it to Second Sister?"
"Your Second Sister doesn’t dare to question what I do, don’t worry!"
Luis noticed her gaze softening and couldn’t resist kissing her little hand, teasing, "How strange. My precious Leah isn’t calling me a pervert or a creep anymore. I almost miss it."
"Stupid brother in law... but you did peek!"
Leah’s tone was almost like coquettish whining now.

The dormitories at City No. 1 School came in two types, two for boys and two for girls, both quite impressive. The old dormitory buildings had standard eight person rooms with only two ceiling fans and shared bathrooms on each floor.

The new dormitory buildings had better conditions, with four person rooms, air conditioning (electricity bills paid separately), and private bathrooms and showers. They were also twice as spacious as the eight person rooms.
The prices were worlds apart. The former was free, while the latter cost 1,000 dollars per semester.
Luis was naturally extravagant and chose the latter without hesitation. He also topped up her meal card with 100 dollars, running around eagerly to get everything settled.
"Brother in law, Mom can’t find out about this, or she’ll scold me to death!!
This was the sentence Leah had repeated the most over the past two days.

But she wore a sweet smile because Luis had thrown all her old living supplies from the military training into the trash without hesitation, clapping his hands and saying, "Got it. You’re so young but already nagging like your mom. I’ll take you to buy new ones tonight."
"Okay~!"
Leah smiled sweetly, her shy, lovestruck expression enough to make anyone’s heart flutter.
The living supplies she had brought were all old household items like cups, basins, and even shampoo that Ruth had scrounged up, cheap or even counterfeit brands.
Especially the old bedsheets and pillow Ruth had prepared, which weren’t even matching and had tacky, gaudy patterns. Luis took one look and immediately tossed them into the trash.
Back home, Mother In Law said she wouldn’t be back for dinner, as Yana, the beautiful young woman, was treating them to a rare meal.
Luis collapsed onto the sofa to rest, since accompanying a woman shopping was exhausting. He checked his phone and saw his balance was now under 18,000 dollars.
The 10,000 dollar reward from the first "Lust System" task wasn’t even enough to buy three bracelets, and now he’d spent another more dollars on Leah in a single day.
Using money to win her over was clearly effective, and Luis had grown to love the feeling of splurging. But now he was frustrated, wanting to unlock more tasks to earn money.

When Lily returned home and saw her husband asleep on the sofa, she tiptoed upstairs. Leah had just finished hanging up her newly washed clothes and froze when she saw her sister, feeling incredibly guilty.
"You little brat, you really went all out, buying so much stuff."
Lily joked, picking up her sister’s new underwear and feeling it approvingly. "The quality is really good, and the style is nice too. You’ve got great taste."
"Well, he’s my brother in law. If the little sister doesn’t take advantage of her brother in law, who will?"
Leah giggled happily. The price tags had been removed, and the receipts were safely hidden.
"The quality is really good. Was it expensive?"
