chapters.title: Chapter 28: Hugging MIL
paragraphs: Just as she was pondering how to bring it up, her phone suddenly rang.
Seeing the caller ID, Ruth’s brows furrowed with anger. "This damn bitch, she’s already taken my money and now she wants to rub it in, huh?"
With that, she tossed her phone aside and sat down angrily, crossing her arms.

The force of her sitting caused her ample chest to bounce, making Luis’s vision swim. Watching his mother-in-law appear angry on the surface but also somewhat restless and unwilling to admit defeat, Luis felt he had become more observant since getting the System. He liked to slyly analyze his targets’ situations and gauge their psychology.
Seeing this, Luis didn’t hesitate to take out his phone.
Ruth’s phone dinged with a notification. She sighed and picked it up, only for her eyes to widen in shock as she looked from the phone to her grinning son-in-law standing beside her.
Luis had directly transferred 1,000 dollars to her.

Considering Arthur only gave her around 2000 dollars a month for living expenses, aside from covering their daughter’s tuition, and maybe a little more during holidays, Ruth had to budget tightly for both household expenses and her card games.
Her eldest daughter couldn’t help much, but Lily was filial and gave her 2000 dollars every month.
Still, with a whole family to support, no matter how frugal she was, money was always tight.
"Mom, is it not enough?"
Luis gritted his teeth and transferred another 1,000 dollars.
Seeing the 2,000 dollars from her son-in-law, Ruth’s face visibly brightened, though she tried not to show it too obviously.

Out of a sense of propriety as an elder, and wanting to maintain her dignity, Ruth demurred, "Son-in-law, this isn’t appropriate. You already spent 10,000 dollars on jewelry for me and Lily, and now you’re giving me so much money again."
"Let me transfer it back. Honestly, if Lily finds out, she’ll say I’m biased and always making you spend money."

Seeing her pretend to reach for her phone but not actually do anything, Luis knew exactly what his mother-in-law was thinking. He suddenly stepped forward and hugged her, startling Ruth so much she nearly screamed.
"Son-in-law, what are you doing!"
Ruth’s breathing grew rapid, her fists clenched tightly, her eyes wide with shock.
But when she realized Luis wasn’t making any inappropriate moves—just hugging her—she felt too awkward to push him away.
Luis didn’t grope her. He simply hugged her face-to-face, and since Ruth’s figure was similar to Lily’s, his head naturally rested on her shoulder.

Her full breasts pressed against his chest through her bra and clothes. Though she immediately leaned back slightly, that brief contact was enough to send Luis’s imagination wild. He could clearly feel just how plump and enormous they were.

Suppressing his lustful thoughts with great effort, Luis spoke in a moved tone, "Mom, you know I might as well be an orphan. Even though I’m a live-in son-in-law, I truly see this place as my home and all of you as my family."
Hearing this, the flustered Ruth hugged Luis back, comforting him gently. "Silly child, what do you mean ’see this as your home’? This is your home. Don’t say such nonsense.
The two held each other like that. Luis inhaled her mature, womanly scent, enjoying the feel of her voluptuous body without crossing any lines.
At this moment, Luis felt desire burning fiercely within him, but knowing it wasn’t the right time yet, he restrained himself with great difficulty.
"Mom, I know you like Daniel because his family is well-off, he’s smooth-talking, and sweet-mouthed. Compared to him, I really can’t measure up. I’m honest and awkward with words..."
Luis felt that playing the weak card was the best way to close the distance with a strong-willed woman like his mother-in-law.
Sure enough, hearing his dejected and aggrieved tone, Ruth suddenly felt a pang of guilt and remorse.
She hugged Luis tighter and consoled him, "Son-in-law, this is actually my fault. These past few days, I’ve realized I’ve been too harsh on you before."

"You and Daniel are both my sons-in-law. This live-in business doesn’t matter—you’re both like half-sons to me. That little bastard Daniel talks sweet but doesn’t spend a dime. He’s not filial, and honestly, I don’t think he even treats your eldest sister well."
"Mom misunderstood you before. Lily has a stubborn, quiet personality and isn’t very affectionate. But lately, I’ve noticed how loving you two are, and Mom is genuinely happy for her."
Luis spoke in a somewhat disbelieving tone, "Mom, really?"
Ruth was still holding onto Luis at this moment. With her impatient personality, she immediately said, "Nonsense, your mom isn’t stupid or brainless."

"Daniel’s family has money, but that’s his parents’ business. He himself is idle and relies on his parents to support him. He’s been mooching off them for some money, but he doesn’t spend it on me or your eldest sister."

"My own son in law is much better. He dotes on his wife and is considerate, works hard to earn money for his wife, and even remembers to show filial respect to me. He’s been busy helping with Leah’s affairs, more reliable than my own two daughters!"
"Son in law, I was foolish and dumb before, making you suffer."

Ruth grew more emotional as she spoke, even gritting her teeth and trembling slightly. "Even if Daniel were really a billionaire, so what? He wouldn’t spend a single cent on me. Only my second son in law truly respects me."
"Mom won’t be foolish anymore, and don’t blame me for treating you poorly before. From now on, Mom will make it up to you double."
Who would’ve thought that a mother in law could have such high awareness? It seemed that the real money he threw at her made her suddenly realize Daniel had been making empty promises all along.
Indeed, money was the greatest sincerity. It even made her IQ skyrocket. The almighty, wicked power of money.

Luis’s wicked thoughts stirred as he looked at his emotionally charged and deeply moved mother in law. He wondered if he should seize the moment to ask for some kind of sensual compensation. Just then, her phone rang again.

At this moment, the two of them, completely lost in their emotions, had no idea that a sneaky figure was hiding at the staircase, her big, watery eyes wide with shock and even horror as she watched the two embrace.
Her own mother, hugging her brother in law, who was only wearing underwear, whispering something that seemed intimate.
Leah felt her brain short circuit. Her breathing grew rapid, and for a moment, it was beyond her comprehension.
When the phone rang, the two quickly separated. Leah’s legs felt weak, but she still hurriedly crawled back upstairs.
She hadn’t meant to eavesdrop. It was just that Ruth had always scolded everyone for not being quiet, saying they moved around like monkeys making a racket.

So whenever Ruth was home, everyone tiptoed up and down the stairs. It was a testament to the mother in law’s domineering presence. Leah had also gotten into the habit of moving quietly downstairs, but she never expected to witness such an explosive scene.
"What do you want, you damn bitch? Three players short?
"My little daughter is home these two days. Didn’t I already tell you? We’re still busy with her school stuff."
"Damn bitch, what nonsense are you spouting? You won just a little from me and now you’re getting cocky."
"Give me ten minutes. Let me see if there’s anything else to do. Just wait, today I’ll strip you down to your underwear."

The relationship between Ruth and this friend of hers was strange. They were both sarcastic and sharp tongued with each other, yet they hung out every day without ever falling out. It was just one of those inexplicable chemical reactions between women.
Women were truly bizarre creatures.
After hanging up, Ruth put on a thoughtful expression, then shook her head and said, "Forget it, I won’t go. The money you gave was to help with household expenses. How could I use it for cards?"
Her act was obvious. Her eyes darted around guiltily as she lied. Only a fool would believe her. Ruth wasn’t exactly a righteous person to begin with.
If someone pretended to be polite and you took it seriously, you were the idiot.
Luis chuckled without saying much. He simply picked up her bag and walked to the wardrobe, asking, "Mom, which outfit do you want to wear?"
"I, I’ll pick it myself..."
Ruth suddenly seemed flustered.
Her wardrobe was slightly messy, with underwear placed conspicuously in an open drawer.
Before she could stop him, Luis swiftly picked out a sleeveless floral dress she often wore, then deftly grabbed a red set of panties and a bra, shoving them into her arms.
Ruth hugged the clothes, her face flushed. She hadn’t expected her son in law to suddenly rummage through her underwear.

Even worse, Luis picked up the bra and checked the size, then smirked and said, "34G. Mom, your bra’s too small, isn’t it? If it’s too tight, you can’t even breathe properly. I’ll take you to buy new ones in a couple of days."
This was pure teasing. Seeing Ruth was about to lose her temper, Luis quickly added, "Mom, trust me. Wear this today, and you’ll dominate the table. You’ll wipe those bitches out."
"What nonsense are you spouting? Get out. Mom needs to change."
Ruth’s face turned red as she glared at him.

Seeing that he’d pushed far enough, Luis didn’t press further. While teasing his mother in law, he’d also gotten fully hard, his cock straining against his underwear, creating a prominent and intimidating tent in his pants.
Ruth was clearly starting to feel wary, so Luis decided to quit while he was ahead and went to the living room to smoke.
"Ding... The favorability meter of the mature and voluptuous mother in law fluctuates..."

Leah was overjoyed, while Luis smiled gently. This time, instead of holding her hand, he wrapped an arm around her. Leah froze for a moment before shyly lowering her head and allowing her Brother to embrace her.
Meanwhile, Luis’s mind was in chaos, feeling as if his intelligence had been brutally challenged.
Despite his best efforts, the System hadn’t triggered any missions. But the moment Leah’s classmate called, the System’s cold voice suddenly echoed in his mind:
"Ding... Mission for the Girl with huge boobs younger sister activated. Mission for the Girl with huge boobs younger sister generating."
What the hell was this trigger condition? He’d been teasing her for two days with no reaction, so why did it activate the moment her classmate called?
And what did "generating" mean? How long would it take? Would it drag on forever?
Luis was feeling irritable now. It was like successfully arranging a hookup—while the idea was exciting, the waiting period was agonizing because you had no idea what would show up.
The midday sun was scorching. Inside the mall’s cold drink shop, Leah happily sipped her juice.

She suddenly spaced out, thinking that the watermelon juice at her school gate cost 0.6 dollars a cup, while this cherry juice was 5.8 dollars. This was way too extravagant. She’d never spend this much if she were out by herself.
As she thought this, she couldn’t help but sneak another glance.

Across from her, Luis was fiddling with his phone, his expression serious and focused. She didn’t dare disturb him, since Second Sister had mentioned that Brother never played games. He must be working.
The way he looked when concentrating on work was kinda handsome too...
Luis was staring intently at the screen because the System seemed displeased and was taunting him—or rather, tempting him.
The apps on his phone moved beyond his control, switching at a speed too fast for the blink of an eye. One unfamiliar app after another opened, giving Luis a true eye opener.
Blockchain mining profits, blockchain cryptocurrency contracts, stock markets from around the world, futures trading and betting contracts, foreign exchange data—it was all a dizzying spectacle.
There were also novel copyrights, scripts, film and television rights, and various patent incomes, most of which were in English and incomprehensible to Luis.
But without exception, all these accounts were registered under Luis’s name, thoroughly broadening his horizons.
"Dormant Bitcoin, dormant Ethereum, dormant stock accounts, dormant account balances."
"For various reasons, including death, over 5% of the total financial volume lies dormant, while nearly 10% of savings have been forgotten."
"Massive dormant capital can be activated at will without affecting the global monetary and financial totals.
"Even if another System were to arrive, it wouldn’t notice, let alone ordinary humans."
Reading the messages in the phone’s dialogue box, Luis realized the System was angry because he kept complaining about it.
After a moment’s thought, he typed into the dialogue box: "I can’t exactly kneel here, so let’s just say I was wrong, okay? But what’s up with the younger sister mission?"
"Ding... Mission for the Girl with huge boobs younger sister generating."
The System completely ignored him, leaving Luis utterly helpless.
This System was seriously tsundere. After showing off its capabilities, it went silent again. But amid the sea of code earlier, Luis had caught a glimpse of something.
There were too many diverse elements at play. It needed to collect and analyze big data—global big data—which was why it had been so sluggish.
"Brother, what’s wrong?"
Seeing Luis heave a deep sigh and finally put his phone down, Leah dared to ask.
Luis chuckled. "It’s nothing, just work stuff. Don’t worry about it."
"Brother, aren’t you going to drink anything?"
Leah asked, her face flushed.
After entering, they had ordered two cherry juices—one for her classmate—while Luis hadn’t bought anything and had just been sitting there on his phone.
Luis looked at her shy expression and continued teasing, "No, Brother isn’t used to drinking these. As long as you like it, baby~"
Leah suddenly felt dazed. She blended right in with the stylish, well dressed young people here, not standing out at all.
But Brother dressed so simply and plainly that it almost seemed out of place. Her mother had once said that Second Sister dressed just as frumpily as he did.
Back then, they said it was because they had no money, but now it was clear that wasn’t the issue. They just refused to spend on themselves.
He’d bought Mom and Second Sister bracelets worth thousands of dollars—the most expensive kind—and hadn’t batted an eye when taking her out to buy clothes and eat.
Yet he was so strict with himself. Leah’s gaze softened, and she suddenly reached out to hold Luis’s hand.
"Brother, I... I only have a little over 10 dollars left. Let me buy you some clothes later, okay?"
This caught Luis off guard. Seeing the affectionate look in his younger sister’s eyes and glancing at the people around them, he immediately understood her thoughts.
With a teasing grin, he asked, "Baby, do you think I’m too tacky?"

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Is He Your Boyfriend?
paragraphs: Leah quickly waved her hands, pouting her little mouth in frustration and said, "I didn’t mean that, don’t talk nonsense. I was just saying that brother in law is also quite good looking. If you dress up a little, you wouldn’t be worse than eldest brother in law."
Luis chuckled, deliberately teasing her with a helpless tone, "Got it, in Leah’s heart I’m worse than Daniel."
"No, I didn’t mean that!"
Leah was completely flustered upon hearing this, slamming the table fiercely and saying, "Eldest brother in law is all talk, and eldest sister isn’t reliable either, how can they compare to you?"
"I just meant that brother in law, it’s not like you don’t have money. If you bought some nicer clothes, you’d look even more handsome."
Seeing her genuinely embarrassed and anxious, Luis quickly grabbed her hand, speaking with deep affection and gentleness,
"Sweetheart, don’t get worked up. In brother in law’s heart, spending 10 dollars on myself is a waste, but if you spend a thousand, I’d think it’s totally worth it."
From the moment they met, Luis had only a few clothes that had been washed until they faded, and he was still wearing them now.
Looking at her own pretty clothes in contrast, Leah’s heart ached. It seemed brother in law was only stingy with himself but utterly generous with her.
"Stupid brother in law..."
Leah murmured, suddenly feeling a slight pang of sadness.
Luis had bought juice for her and her friend. There was sugar free ice water here for just 0.5 dollars, but Luis didn’t buy any. Now, as he spoke, he subtly swallowed his saliva.

She didn’t realize this saliva was because she had practically placed her chest on the table. She just felt brother in law was too harsh on himself, and for a moment, she felt guilty but didn’t know how to express it.
"Bunny!"
Suddenly, a girl sat down and hugged Leah tightly.
Her denim shorts accentuated her slender, beautiful legs, and her little black tank top exuded a youthful vibe. Most importantly, she was the same type as the sister in law.

Petite in stature but exceptionally full chested, the curves were visible even through her clothes. The round and plump contours were very clear, showing she was wearing a bra but also hinting at her hidden depths.
She carried a quirky little bag, and her outfit looked a bit old fashioned, clearly hand me downs.
Her features were delicate and pretty, almost on par with the sister in law, but she had a short bob cut, giving her a fresh and clean look.
"Bunny??"
Luis looked utterly confused.
Leah gasped and immediately covered her mouth, flustered and angry, "Avery, shut your mouth."
"Leah, behave."
Leah’s struggles were useless. This new little girl had her in a grip, practically groping her chest while laughing, "Why are you overreacting so much?"
"Seriously, what do you think?!"
Being manhandled like this in front of her brother in law, Leah was furious, her face burning with anger as she shoved her away.
She was almost at the point of losing her temper. The new petite, big chested girl let go of her and scoffed, "Can’t even take a joke? We always do this normally."
Leah was seething, her face red as she snapped, "Are you insane? This is a public place."
Her little friend suddenly extended her hand, smiling sweetly, "Brother in law, hello! I’m Avery!"
"Hello!"
Luis was so confused his head hurt. He couldn’t help but ask curiously, "Why is she called Bunny?"
Avery was about to answer when she caught Leah’s murderous glare, her eyes practically spitting fire, which was genuinely intimidating.
She immediately stuck out her tongue and said playfully, "Brother in law, if you’re interested, ask her yourself. If you really can’t get it out of her, I’ll secretly tell you later."
Then Avery suddenly looked suspicious and asked, "Leah, is this really your brother in law? I’ve met your brother in law before."
If she’d met him, it was probably Daniel. Leah rolled her eyes and said, "Do you have to know every single relative in my family?"
"I’m just looking out for you!"
Avery hugged her warmly, giving Luis a suggestive look, "If he’s your boyfriend, no need to hide it."
"I already said he’s my brother in law. You’re so annoying, you little bitch."

Watching two petite, big chested girls playfully bicker was one of life’s greatest pleasures, especially since both had sweet, doll like voices. Their laughter was so sugary it felt like a sugar overdose.
Every man in the cold drink shop was swallowing hard as they watched, then shooting Luis looks of envy and resentment.
Luis basked in these hostile gazes, enjoying the sight of their unrestrained chest movements as they roughhoused. It was a visual feast.
After some discussion, the two girls settled on McDonald’s for lunch. It seemed the allure of fast food for young girls was undeniable.
After eating, they went shopping at the supermarket. Luis pushed the cart behind them, now clearly feeling like the third wheel with the arrival of the little friend.
"Brother in law, this is a bit expensive!
After checking out, they went to another shop for ice cream. Avery ate while staring at Luis, then at Leah, her expression odd.
Leah, already feeling guilty, couldn’t take it anymore and snapped angrily, "Avery, what are you looking at with those shifty eyes? You’ve been acting weird all day."
"Me acting weird? Look who’s talking!"
Avery said suspiciously, "Is this really your brother in law??"
Leah rolled her eyes and was about to retort when Luis asked, amused, "Why is that so hard to believe?"
"It doesn’t add up. You pick expensive things you wouldn’t even buy for yourself, yet he puts them in the cart without hesitation, even complaining that what you picked isn’t expensive enough."
"He’s being way too generous."
Avery said seriously, "It’s not just that. I noticed something was off the moment I arrived, and now I’m even more convinced."
"You’re insane. What’s off?"
Leah rolled her eyes again.
Avery smirked and pointed at Leah, "That dress is new. I’ve never seen it before. Those shoes are new too. Your mom is so stingy, there’s no way she’d buy you such expensive clothes."
"We’re the same, pockets emptier than our faces. So, what’s the deal with these new clothes?"
Leah rolled her eyes, exasperated, "What do you mean ’what’s the deal’? Brother in law bought them for me. Avery, you’re seriously out of your mind."
Avery put on her detective face and snorted, "I don’t buy it. Those sandals? My cousin bought a pair. What kind of proper brother in law buys his sister in law something that expensive?"
"I see what you’re doing. You’re insulting me!"
Luis was both amused and exasperated. What did she mean by a ’proper brother in law’? Was she implying he wasn’t proper?
"Avery, you’re seriously delusional. A pair of shoes, and you’ve spun this whole conspiracy theory??"
Leah was also at a loss for words, scolding, "If he’s not my brother in law, who do you think he is?"
"Hey, handsome, come clean. Are you trying to hit on my best friend?"
Avery giggled, "If you are, there’s no need to be shy. You’re clearly putting in a lot of effort, so you must be serious."

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Ulterior Motives, Impure Intentions
paragraphs: Luis hadn’t even opened his mouth when Leah was already rolling her eyes.
"You have serious issues, Avery. Plenty of people chase after me. If I really had a boyfriend, why would I be scared to tell you?"
"Yes yes, our Leah has been the school belle since childhood. There really are many people chasing you, both men and women."
This one sentence nearly made Luis spit out his water.
Leah’s face turned red as she scolded, "What nonsense are you spouting?"

"I’m not spouting nonsense. Wasn’t that flat chested tomboy chasing you before? Don’t worry, she did poorly on her exams and went to a school in another district. She can’t sexually harass you anymore."
"Being harassed by a girl is better than being harassed by a guy, right? That fat pig confessed to you last time, it was disgusting..."
Seeing Luis already coughing, Avery said nonchalantly, "Brother in law, what’s so surprising about this?"
"No, nothing!"
Luis felt like he was too old fashioned, or maybe society had become too open. In any case, he couldn’t view his sister in law as an innocent blank slate anymore.
Avery continued her suspicious questioning, "You didn’t even know this? Are you really her brother in law?"
Leah said irritably, "Avery, that’s enough. Even if he’s my brother in law, I don’t have to tell him these things."
Avery stroked her chin and continued scrutinizing Luis, who was both amused and exasperated. Leah couldn’t take it anymore, "Do you have to see my sister’s marriage certificate to believe it?"
"I didn’t say that. I’m just reasonably suspicious. What kind of proper brother in law would be so generous?"
In the end, it still came down to Luis being improper. Luis was also getting a headache and wanted to crack open her skull to see what kind of bizarre thought process this girl had.
"Unless... there’s another possibility!"
Avery’s expression gradually turned serious.
Leah, who had been rendered speechless by her, still asked, "What possibility?"
"Ulterior motives, impure intentions."

Avery grinned with a lewd expression, "A sister in law is half a brother in law’s ass. Being overly generous without reason is either theft or adultery... Being so generous definitely means there’s something shady going on."

Hearing this, Leah’s heart grew even more guilty because Luis had been intimately teasing her these past two days. Although there hadn’t been any inappropriate actions, if you said it was purely innocent, what kind of brother in law kisses his sister in law’s feet?
If you said Luis saw her purely as a sister and had no ulterior motives, even Leah herself wouldn’t believe such nonsense.
Luis, however, didn’t panic. Instead, he smiled and said, "So after observing for so long and analyzing so much, what’s your conclusion?
"Well... I don’t have a specific judgment yet!"
Avery saw that Luis wasn’t flustered or guilty at all. Instead, he was looking at her like she was a silly child, which made her angry and embarrassed, "What are you looking at!"
"At a monkey. You’ve been acting all mysterious for so long. Let’s go!"
Leah grabbed her and pulled her away.

The scorching afternoon wasn’t spent wandering around. If not for this third wheel, watching a movie or going on a date would have been nice. But with this neurotic third wheel around, there was no mood for that.
When they got home, the two girls ran upstairs, diligently washing the sheets and quilt covers. Then they closed the door, and who knew what they were talking about.

In any case, their relationship was really good. In Luis’s impression, his sister in law Leah was a quiet and well behaved girl. Now, she was calling people "bitches" and saying they were "sick," which made her seem more down to earth.

"Shameless!"

Lily naturally sat on her mother’s bed, and Luis unceremoniously followed, lying down casually like the man of the house, even resting his head directly on Father-in-law Arthur’s pillow.
Lily didn’t think much of it, but Ruth gave him a sidelong glance, feeling a bit strange, recalling her son-in-law’s odd words.

The mother and daughter shared almost everything, but when it came to Nancy, they held back a little, not wanting to badmouth her too much in front of Luis.

The strange friendship between Mother-in-law Ruth and her girlfriends involved cursing each other to their faces while talking behind each other’s backs when apart. Yet, they still called themselves childhood besties, often gathering to play cards or something.
They even went for beauty treatments or shopping for Luis’s clothes together, occasionally traveling nearby for meals. But whenever they opened their mouths, the first words out were always curses.
"Power outage?"
The cause was a community notice about a planned power outage lasting a full day and night to upgrade the aging electrical lines, a perfectly normal situation in daily life.

But Mother-in-law Ruth ended up being mocked, especially by Yana, the pretty young wife, who "kindly" invited Ruth to spend the night at her place, since sleeping without AC in this weather was practically impossible.
Ruth grew angrier the more she thought about it, gritting her teeth and saying, "That slut, that bitch, clearly mocking me."
It wasn’t that Ruth had a persecution complex. Back when this area was being demolished, Yana’s then-still-alive husband and Arthur were both considered big shots in the relocation.

But Arthur chose these two one-bedroom, two-living-room units to create a duplex for the mother and her three daughters, while the rest of the money was diverted for business—or, according to the Wood family, spent on that vixen of a mistress.

Yana, on the other hand, didn’t take the property but opted for cash compensation. Her husband later borrowed some money and bought a three-bedroom, one-living-room apartment with a large balcony in the Sky Garden across the street, a luxurious 120-square-meter home.
The Wood family’s so-called duplex was just a cheap knockoff project, with the upper and lower floors combined barely exceeding 80 square meters, making it very cramped.

Worse, this was a resettlement community with practically no greenery or amenities, and the property management was nonexistent, leaving it dirty, chaotic, and unpleasant. At 500 dollars per square meter, it was practically unsellable.
Things were still somewhat manageable now, but once the elevators aged and other issues arose, living here would become unbearable, which was why many had already sold their units.
In contrast, the Sky Garden across the street, developed by Tiger Real Estate, was a local high-end project with greenery and overall environmental quality far superior to this side.

And the Sky Garden was the city’s largest and most luxurious real estate project, with four phases, including riverside villas, where even ordinary units started at over 1,000 dollars per square meter—double the price.
Locals joked that one side of the street was the slums for the native poor, while the other was the rich district for the local elite.
Ruth fumed, "She just wants to show off her place, always bragging about how much it’s appreciated. It pisses me off."
Lily said helplessly, "Mom, why get mad over this? We live our own lives."
"You don’t get it, that bitch is doing it on purpose, damn it."
Ruth was seething, while Lily found it amusing but didn’t say much. After all, the strange friendship between her mother and her girlfriends was hard for outsiders to understand.

But for Luis, this was a great opportunity. His eyes lit up as he quickly tried to please her, saying, "Mom, don’t be angry. If she brings it up again tomorrow, just ignore her. Tell her we’re spending the night at Ocean World instead."

Ocean Grand Hotel, the city’s largest ultra-five-star hotel complex, was located on Seaview Road and covered a vast area with extreme luxury. Ocean World, its attached bath and leisure center, was also the city’s largest and most high-end.
"Yeah, just brush it off!"
Mother and daughter didn’t take it seriously, casually mentioning it before Luis hugged his wife and returned to their room.
Once the door closed, they locked lips, and the sparks instantly ignited. The lust stirred up earlier by sister-in-law Leah and Avery now flared up fiercely.

The faint sounds of passionate moans seeped through the walls—the poor soundproofing of this shabby place was no joke. Not only did sister-in-law Leah next door blush upon hearing it, but even Ruth downstairs, already in bed, felt her face heat up.
Her daughter’s satisfied moans were like a cat in heat, claws scratching at one’s heart, making it unbearably itchy.

The buzzing sound made her freeze—the vibrator should’ve been out of battery. And when she touched it, the size and shape didn’t match the one she’d used before. The vibrations were stronger too.
Ruth abruptly sat up, turned on the light, and looked at the vibrator.

The handwriting was unmistakably her son-in-law Luis’s, and only he knew this secret—not even her husband Arthur was aware.
"That damn little pervert, what kind of son-in-law gives his mother-in-law something like this as a gift..."
Ruth’s face burned red. She turned off the light and lay back down, placing the vibrator aside, torn between anger and amusement, thinking she should just sleep.
But her daughter’s moans continued, faint yet melodious, making it impossible to calm down, especially with her already restless, lustful body.
"Little bastard..."

The buzzing grew muffled, and Ruth moaned in pleasure, biting her lower lip as she secretly used both hands to pleasure her mature, thirsty body under the covers.

paragraphs: Lily used a soft look to signal him not to order something too expensive. Luis kissed her on the cheek before calling the waiter.
"My mother loves steak, so please bring one of these grilled Wagyu ribeye platters, and also add an extra portion of beef tenderloin."
"My wife loves seafood, so please steam this local lobster, and make the lobster head with garlic butter separately."
"Wife, you love king prawns the most, so bring one portion of the signature jumbo prawns..."

Lily’s personality made her feel a bit frightened listening to this, but fortunately at this time Luis looked at the menu and said, "Add a Caesar salad, and then give these three ladies one abalone and ginseng soup each."
"For alcohol, please bring a bottle of red wine."
After ordering, Yana couldn’t help but say, "Sister Ruth, your son in law is much more generous than you."
"Nonsense, my son in law is not without money."
Ruth immediately retorted, "But spending this money to treat you is a bit not worth it."
Luis knew that today was a good opportunity to please his mother in law and increase her favorability meter. It should be his stage to perform, and he must seize every opportunity.
"Mom, you don’t need to say that. Sister Yana is your good friend and also an elder we should respect."
Luis passed the complimentary bread basket to them while speaking softly, "At least open up the road to wealth for the poor. Since we’re out, there’s no need to save money when spending."
"Damn, your son in law makes sense."
Yana praised.

The red wine arrived before the food. It was expensive but the service was thorough. They poured it for everyone and used high end wine glasses. At this moment, it seemed like finding any reason to refuse would be a sin.
The first dish was the steamed lobster. Luis directly picked up a piece and put it in his wife’s plate.
Knowing she was very distressed, so she needed comfort, Ruth started to cause trouble at this moment: "Your mother is still sitting here, and your eyes only see your wife."

Yana, who was even better at causing trouble than her, immediately insinuated, "You’re jealous of your own daughter, are you even human? I was wondering why you always said this son in law was useless and annoying before. The young couple is so loving, are you trying to break up the family?"
Lily shyly spoke up and said, "Aunt Yana, maybe my personality is not good at talking, but Luis treats me very well. I just don’t know how to express it."
As soon as these words were spoken, Ruth’s pretty face turned red. She glared at her and said, "I’m afraid telling the truth would trigger you, you widowed dead bitch.
"I’m widowed, you’re living in widowhood, where does your sense of superiority come from."
Yana rolled her eyes at her.
The dishes came out one after another. While they were bickering, Luis quietly showed affection to his wife. These small actions had already moved his wife Lily deeply.
After all, in her and other people’s eyes, this was still the same ugly woman from before. When had she ever received such gentle care from her husband?

The food was all served. They drank one bottle of wine and ordered another. Yana swayed her wine glass and said, "By the way, Luis, your mother said you have achieved financial freedom. If you have a way to make money, why not bring her along?"
"She borrowed a few thousand from me at the beginning of the year and just paid me back a couple of days ago."
As soon as these words were spoken, Ruth was a bit angry. She saw that her daughter Lily even looked guilty and subconsciously looked at Luis again.
Luis clinked glasses with her, took a sip, put down the glass, lit a cigarette, and said casually, "Sister, any investment carries risks."

Actually, the mother in law was panicking inside. Luis didn’t know about her borrowing money at the beginning of the year. It definitely wasn’t for living expenses but because she lost at cards. If exposed, it would greatly affect her image as a mother in her daughter’s heart.
"Has risks?"
Yana said with a smile, "Is the risk greater than gambling?"
"It’s not the same."
Luis thought for a moment and said, "If the investment makes money, everyone is happy. If it loses money, they will blame me, so I just do these things myself."
"Even my wife doesn’t know!"
Yana heard this and seemed unconvinced, saying, "How do you know it’s a sure win? With the money you earned, you still dare to invest."
"This... explaining it to you, it seems you wouldn’t understand!"
Luis always maintained respectful language, but his tone carried a humble look down. Ruth silently gave praise. The favorability meter adjusted but the data wouldn’t come out that quickly.
"I still don’t understand? The stock market is one thing, but I’ve been tricked by those blockchain things before.
Yana’s emotions were a bit heightened.
"Shitcoins, they trick a bunch of people, it’s normal."
Luis said casually, "Sister Yana, what you know is a bit lacking. Who would mess with those shitcoins?"
"When blockchain contracts first came out, do you know how to play them?"
"How to play?"
Yana was a bit stunned and subconsciously followed up with the question.
"5000 dollars for one leveraged contract, you could lose everything at any time, but after it’s liquidated, you won’t be in debt."

Luis actually didn’t understand either, but he effortlessly came up with it and let out a deep cold laugh, "I lost ten hands, fifty thousand dollars just gone like that. With the leverage multiplier, winning once would be 1 million."
These words made Yana dumbfounded. Actually, not just her, Lily and her mother couldn’t understand either.

Because Luis was purely talking nonsense. Ruth was very satisfied seeing her expression and immediately said, "Alright, what do you, a woman, understand? Do you understand the business my son in law does?"
"Bullshit, what don’t I understand? I know about Bitcoin. I know about Ethereum."
"Back then, I just didn’t think enough about investing. Otherwise, I would be financially free too."
Luis silently poured her more wine. Yana also drank. Once she drank, she became a bit excited and said, "I’m talking to your son in law. Where do you get so much nonsense from you?"

At this point, Yana was a bit excited. Looking at Luis, she said, "You boy, don’t you have no education? Your mother in law always scolds you for having no culture, saying you can’t even get into a good company. How did you become so interested in this?"
This made Ruth almost lower her head in shame, mainly because the way Lily looked at her was even a bit angry.

A woman’s jealousy is terrifying. Yana immediately added, "If you really have prospects, why be a live in son in law? Your mother in law always scolds you, and why did you go to that Tiger Real Estate?"
"I have a friend who works at Tiger Real Estate. You were just working as a junior shitty accountant there."
"You have prospects? If you really have prospects, why work as a accountant earning those few pathetic dollars?"
"Listen to your aunt, don’t learn from your mother like this, pretending to be fat when you’re actually skinny. This money isn’t of shady origin, is it?"

paragraphs: This was almost like stabbing a knife into the heart, Ruth was so embarrassed and angry she was almost going crazy.

However, Luis knew this was an opportunity. He lightly raised his wine glass and took a sip, saying, "Aunt Yana, I am a live in son in law because my mother requested it. I love my wife, so I agreed."
"My mother in law scolds me because she loves me. It’s just like school, if the teacher doesn’t scold you, it means they’ve given up on you."

"As for working as a accountant at Tiger Real Estate, it’s even simpler. I don’t want to become disconnected from society. At least I can maintain some social skills. The money is a bit less, but that doesn’t matter to me."
"Being a accountant, coming into contact with the bottom of society, dealing with those mean and shrewish bitches, is actually good for me."

Luis knew he had done the right thing. Looking at the envy in Yana’s eyes, he knew how vindicated his mother in law felt.

The root cause was that this pretty widow Yana had a son and held onto old traditions, looking down on his mother in law who had given birth to three daughters. Although these days people don’t favor boys over girls as much, there are inevitably still those with such old fashioned thinking.
Luis immediately sneered and said, "One filial son or son in law is enough. What’s the use of having ten sons if not a single one is filial?"

Normally, given Ruth’s personality, she should have added fuel to the fire, but since she had already gained the upper hand, she started being sarcastic again:
"Son in law, it’s not right for you to say that. Aunt Yana’s son is still studying, so we can’t talk about whether he’s filial or not yet."

Yana immediately rolled her eyes at her and said, "Mind your own business. You’ve been idle your whole life, what right do you have to say that?"
Ruth said smugly, "But I’m beautiful and lucky. I had a husband to support me in the first half of my life, and I have a son in law to support me in the second half."
Listening to these bitches being sarcastic was really fun. Luis and his wife Lily exchanged a smile, both finding it amusing.
After eating and drinking their fill, Luis was not stingy. With a wave of his hand, he booked a four person massage room in the leisure area and ordered massage and foot reflexology services.
Yana said with some worry, "It will be so late after the massage. There will be no space left to sleep in the lobby later."

The rest lounge was free for overnight stays. Many people on business trips chose to stay here because it was more cost effective than a hotel. The downside was that you had to claim a spot early to have a place to sleep.

The chairs in the Ocean World rest lounge were very large and comfortable, but the number was limited, playing on scarcity marketing. If there really was no place to stay, you would have to pay to get a room.
Seizing the moment, Luis said, "It’s fine, I’ve already booked an ocean view room. We have a place to sleep tonight."
"That’s so expensive!"
Ruth felt heartbroken just hearing it.
Ocean Hotel was the most expensive five star hotel. Everyone fought for the rest lounge because the rooms were expensive. The term "ocean view room" just reeked of money.

Luis smiled and explained, "Mom, since we’re out, don’t think about saving money. The rest lounge is noisy and crowded, with people snoring and drunkards. It’s safer to get a room since I’m with all of you."
Hearing this, even the usually thrifty and cautious Lily agreed, "Yes, Mom, Luis considered it very thoroughly. Having a good night’s rest is important too."
Foot massage, body massage, ear cleaning, they did it all. She felt heartache but also enjoyed it.
Then the three women enjoyed facial cleansing, masks, and other services. Luis took this free time to enter the system.
He casually grabbed a code and drew the second blind box reward.
"Ding... Little sister in law task double reward activated."
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining the functional reward: Emotion Display."
"Using this skill on a mission target can instantly display their emotional state. It is one of the auxiliary skills for conquest missions."
Luis opened his eyes, already sensing that there were two items in his inventory: Aphrodisiac Incense (male) and this Emotion Display.
He looked at his wife next to him, then at his mother in law. Both were quiet with masks on. Knowing his wife inside and out, it seemed this function wasn’t needed for her.

His relationship with his little sister in law Leah had improved rapidly and she was easy to deceive. His relationship with his mother in law had warmed further. Now only the task line for his distant older sister in law Nancy remained unactivated.
After thinking about it, Luis used the skill on his mother in law, Ruth.
Instantly, after her favorability meter of 75%, additional terms appeared: comfortable, relaxed, proud.
After all the enjoyment, they were so comfortable their bones felt loose. Their walking was soft, even a bit unsteady.
It was almost midnight when he took them back to the room. Yana frowned and said, "Only one room?
Ruth, already lying on the middle bed, rolled her eyes at her and said irritably, "It’s not like you have to sleep on the floor. Why so picky? If you want to sleep alone, go get your own room."
"Whatever, why would I be picky!"
Yana immediately lay down on the bed near the bathroom, sneered and said, "What haven’t I seen? Even if the young couple gets intimate, it’s fine. If they dare, I dare to watch the show."
Ruth immediately retorted, "Pah, what are you thinking? Almost menopausal and still don’t know how to be proper."

Luis adjusted the temperature and closed the curtains, leaving only dim lighting in the room. He smiled and said, "Mom, Lily has to go to work early tomorrow morning, so we’ll sleep first. You and Aunt Yana chat."

After saying that, Luis pulled his wife and together they got into the bed. Under the covers, Luis became restless. He touched her and whispered quietly, "Wife, wearing clothes feels uncomfortable, let’s just take them off."

Earlier, Luis had observed and noticed that they were all wearing bras. It was understandable that his wife Lily, being conservative, would wear one, but he truly had not expected that those two bitches, despite their foul mouths, would also be so conservative.
"Sleeping with it on is uncomfortable, be good, we are under the covers!"
Lily hesitated a little, but wearing a bra really made it impossible to sleep. At home, she was used to sleeping naked, accustomed to her husband’s warm embrace.

Now, with an extra bathrobe, it felt overly awkward. Lily’s face flushed with shyness as she cooperated with small movements. After taking off the bathrobe, Luis immediately took off her bra and placed it to the side.
Then Luis took his off too, stripping completely naked, and put all the removed clothes on the chair beside them.

Compared to Lily’s bashfulness, the married women were much more open, especially after drinking so much red wine that evening. It was faintly visible that they seemed to have taken off their bras and placed them aside, then started chatting.
"Fuck, yesterday my hand was just cursed, how could I mistake the six of bamboos for the nine of bamboos and throw it away? I was waiting for the three and six of bamboos."
"Bullshit, if I hadn’t spotted Aunt Kiara cheating, you brainless fool would have just paid her."

"I’m telling you, thirteen orphans is just sinister. Ever since I won by self draw last month, I haven’t won a single hand this month..."

The red wine had a bit of a strong aftereffect. They spoke with the boldness that comes from drunkenness, chatting enthusiastically, gossiping and talking about cards. They could probably chat all night without stopping.
On the final bed, Lily bit her lip slightly and let out soft gasps.
